method: Per-epic Sonnet reviewers against six prototype maps, each review re-checked by an adversarial Sonnet verifier; plus a verified data-model delta and a verified reverse check.

themes.title: Contract-centred billing model
themes.description: Billing route, Type 1/2/3 and protected default Type 1s replaced by holders, dated Contract versions, standalone lines, one No contract (RVG), mandatory Contract per Procedure, staged review, authorisation snapshot. XL, split into model, versioning screens, picker.

themes.title: Pricing, units and modifiers
themes.description: Price, rate and discount held on the Procedure with no reason, Contract flag gating anaesthetist, no-charge invoice, modifier split above four, RVG hidden-key master, modifier records with explanations, age pre-applied, out-of-range warns, completion rules reworked. XL.

themes.title: Hospital intake matching screen
themes.description: No review-and-merge screen exists; HL7/FHIR and PDF rows auto-apply. Need staged rows, match/create/Draft List/reject, per-row change type, differences for approval, unmatched queue, day move as cancel plus new, edits until AUTHORISED. XL.

themes.title: NHI mandatory and text as received
themes.description: Remove provisional patients and NHI pending; waiting-for-NHI queue; procedure text kept per source with time; separate invoice description. M, bundled with intake.

themes.title: Prepayment and holding account
themes.description: Prepaid Contract triggers prepayment at line price, admin approval with letter, payable to holding account, second pair at authorise, refund on cancel, no automatic balance. Anaesthetist currently paid before the procedure. XL.

themes.title: Events, additional invoices and credit notes
themes.description: Post-op addendum Booking replaced by events on the Procedure, free-form additional invoices, credit then rebill, negative payables netted in a weekly payment cycle. XL.

themes.title: Edit window until AUTHORISED and anaesthetist views
themes.description: Anaesthetist edits stay open on SUBMITTED, List leaves main view at AUTHORISED, balances show invoices immediately, search and scroll-back. M.

themes.title: OQ-81 reversal: unavailability is never a conflict
themes.description: Remove availability conflict kind, make closed sessions non-assignable by the office, route sickness through return-or-assign to a Draft List. M to L, independent.

themes.title: Single-Booking move and notification pool
themes.description: Anaesthetist moves one Booking into a new List in a colleague's free Slot; pool notices gain resolve tick, count, show-resolved and an ask-the-office source. M.

themes.title: Payer, insurer, balances and warnings
themes.description: Payer name and email on the Booking, insurer and approval number on the Booking, patient balance alerts, remaining warning rules, ledger positions, split as a Booking action. L, after Contract rework.

themes.title: Profile, reporting and admin polish
themes.description: Drop GST period, add bank details, monthly GST of payments passed on, flat owed list, preferred pairing ordering, audit exclusions, cutover load, master calendar, simulated sign-in, scale and privacy demos, point-of-need help. M, mostly small.

epics.title: Schedule canvas, Slots and Lists
epics.observations:
EP-01 is mostly built (catch-up phases 17, 28 to 32), and the reviewer's grades held up on re-check. The one change is US-01.5.4, whose verdict stands but whose missing_or_wrong list I corrected.

Gaps:

1. **OQ-81 reversal not applied.** This one root change drives US-01.5.2, 01.5.4 and 01.6.3, and touches 01.5.5 and the Reassign flow in 01.4.1.
   - conflicts.ts still derives an 'availability' conflict kind.
   - The seed keeps Rutherford's Wed 22 AM List on an Unavailable session.
   - 'Simulate sickness' is written as an office-recorded flag (demoSimulations.ts header: 'OQ-81 part 3, provisional').
   - assignListToSlot, assignDraftList and ReassignListFlow 'Not available' all accept-and-flag closed sessions.
   - Office availability writes can leave a List on a closed Slot.
   - ConflictsScreen has the 'Anaesthetist unavailable' reason and filter.
   - Fix: remove the kind, make closed sessions non-assignable by the office, and have 'Simulate sickness' take the return-or-assign path to a Draft List.
   - Also needed: a PERSIST_VERSION bump, canvas-golden fixtures, and demo guide S2 Beats 1b, 3 and 3a.
2. **Single-Booking move by an anaesthetist (US-01.4.7) is absent.**
   - The office-only MoveBookingFlow cannot create the receiver's List.
   - US-01.4.2's name search has no move picker to attach to.
   - US-01.4.6's prepay holding account depends on EP-06 (US-06.5.1 and 06.5.4).
3. **Small gaps.**
   - The mark-unavailable prompt does not ask the vacated-Slot question (US-01.5.5).
   - Only the web grid has a name search (US-01.4.2).
   - Preferred pairing is only marked, not used to order candidates; US-01.4.2 wording is ambiguous on this.
   - Tier labels read 'Tier 1 to 4', not Gold Elite to Bronze (OQ-102 open, so not graded as a gap).
4. **Catalogue inconsistency to raise.** US-01.5.4's AC says a reassign clears a hospital-closure conflict. That cannot hold, because the hospital stays closed. It worked only for the removed availability kind.
5. **Dependencies.**
   - EP-06 holding account.
   - US-02.3.3 update email and FT-13.8 notification pool, for the optional mover notify in US-01.4.7.
   - OQ-113 (anaesthetist colleague ordering) is open, and the built behaviour follows the written text.

epics.title: Booking intake and change handling
epics.observations:
Core gap: the matching / review-and-merge screen does not exist. Code comments name it 'Phase 33' (types.ts:567 reserves a 'hospitalRow' Draft List origin; integrationActions.ts:149,169,198 are 'interim until Phase 33'; IntegrationMonitorScreen/DemoIntegrations Future notes reference it). Nothing is held for review: HL7/FHIR messages apply immediately; PDF rows ingest only onto ACTIVE Lists. One build (staged rows, match / create / Draft List / assign / reject, per-row change type, no-NHI hold, as-received text) closes EP-02, FT-02.1, FT-02.5 and US-02.1.1/2/4/5 together; item sizes overlap, total about XL.

Verifier changes: US-02.1.1 and US-02.1.2 regraded Partial to Contradicts (wrong behaviour implemented: direct apply; no-NHI PDF row becomes a Booking; text overwritten). US-02.3.1 stays Partial but two reviewer points were false (procedure text IS editable via EditProcedureSheet) and were dropped. Others upheld; FT-02.4 Matches confirmed.

Cross-cutting rules the build must change together: (1) NHI mandatory, no provisional patients (intake.ts, ManualBookingForm canSave, nhiBadge 'NHI pending', seed PT0010 and provisionalNoNhi scenario, mobile/web/admin booking detail); (2) day move as cancel plus new Booking, and integration/inbound edits allowed on SUBMITTED Lists until authorised (lifecycle.editRefusal integrationImmutable, reassignBooking ACTIVE-to-ACTIVE rule); (3) procedure source text per origin with source and time, never overwritten (Procedure type, createBooking, ingestPdfRow, EditProcedureSheet, picker, seed, PERSIST_VERSION bump); (4) CPH third feed and its S4 dead-letter beat sit outside the two in-scope hospitals.

Cross-epic links: EP-14 (HL7/FHIR/feeds, OQ-109), FT-02.2 / US-02.2.x (surgeon PDF, Future; note the Surgeon PDFs tab carries no Future badge though the epic says automatic PDF reading is Future Work), US-02.5.1/2/4/5, FT-01.6 Draft Lists (exists, reusable as a match outcome), EP-03 (US-03.1.9 source text beside Contract/RVG), EP-08 (US-08.4.6 invoice description, OQ-103).

Demo-guide impact (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S1 Beat 1 (Fire hospital message creates the booking, ~113-131) and its 'arrives in a later build' line; S2 phone-advice beat (~250-258) needs the optional 'as given' field; S4 exception beats (MSG-CPH-2001 dead-letter, feed-mapping fix, STG-1002, ~568-624) and the Integrations Future-scope framing need rewriting. FT-02.4 ad hoc add beats unchanged apart from NHI-mandatory.

epics.title: Booking and Procedure capture (anaesthetist)
epics.observations:
Verifier result: 30 items, 7 corrected (US-03.1.6 Missing to Partial; US-03.1.9 Partial to Contradicts; US-03.2.2 Missing to Partial; US-03.3.3 Partial to Contradicts; US-03.3.8 Missing to Partial; US-03.5.2 Partial to Contradicts; and the rest upheld with added points). Re-checked every Agreed item against code.

Structural: prototype is built on the old model (Procedure.billingRoute hospital|billableParty|insurer plus optional governingContractId on Contract Type 1/2/3; no Contract lines, no RVG groups (seed codes are 5-digit numbers, so 'H1' type-ahead finds nothing), no per-Contract anaesthetist-can-adjust flag, no events, no credit notes). Closing EP-03 mostly means reworking the single shared capture body (shared/booking/BookingDetailBody + shared/capture/*), shared/flows/EditProcedureSheet and domain/billing validate/fee, so mobile and web move together.

One validator drives many gaps: validateBookingForBilling (domain/billing/validateBookingForBilling.ts:126-230) forces route, RVG code or billing line, start and 'handover' times, in-range base selection, insurer/prepayment fields and an override reason. Reworking it to the catalogue (Contract set, times only where Contract prices from time, modifier explanation, RVG optional, no override reason, 'finish' wording) closes parts of FT-03.3, US-03.3.1, 03.3.3, 03.5.1, 03.5.2, 03.6.1 at once.

Newly found points: the anaesthetist is shown no price anywhere on the Booking (showBookingTotal), yet the web List table shows units and Fee, so the hiding is inconsistent and conflicts with 'fixed price shown read-only' (FT-03.5); the zero-total invoice group is skipped and negative totals are refused as 'credit note never raised' (invoiceBuild.ts:409-423; validator), against no-charge invoices (US-03.5.1) and credit events (US-03.7.2/7.3); SubmitListSheet confirm copy says bookings cannot be changed after submit, contradicting the until-AUTHORISED window; price overrides are not flagged at office review (reviewFlags covers only completeness, missing reference, ACC route and B/T/M overrides); the post-op addendum fails when neither of today's sessions is free.

Edit-rights change: editRefusal locks the anaesthetist at SUBMITTED; catalogue keeps Contract/RVG edits open until AUTHORISED while submit still hands the List to the office. Needs a per-field rule, not the blanket ACTIVE-only matrix (lifecycle.ts:50-76, BookingDetailBody.tsx:313, BtmCaptureBlock.tsx:114 editable).

Received text: Procedure.description is overwritten by Edit operation; catalogue keeps rooms and hospital wording exactly as received and adds a separate invoice description (US-08.4.6, OQ-103). Needs separate fields.

Dependencies: Contract model, lines, flag and 'No contract (RVG)' (EP-04: US-04.2.4, US-04.3.2 to 04.3.4); RVG groups, base units and ranges (EP-05, OQ-101); fixed discount and office price change (US-05.4.2/5.4.3); additional invoices and credit notes (US-08.6.x) for events; notification pool (FT-13.8, OQ-79) for US-03.6.3; out-of-range warning routine (US-13.7.1); office review flagging (US-07.2.2); NHI mandatory affects patient model, seeds and the phone-advice booking flow (EP-02/EP-09); age modifier (OQ-95); search needs billed Lists kept reachable.

Quick wins (S): NHI mandatory, 'finish' wording, prepaid amount banner, age modifier pre-apply, drop ASA seed, remove mandatory override reason, make-primary action, Contract and pricing-basis line.

Demo-script impact (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S1 Beat 3 (pick 20950, Start now, Finish now, Mark complete; ASA, numeric RVG codes) changes when RVG becomes optional, ASA stops seeding and modifiers need explanations; S4 Beat 2 'post-op addendum' (Stage post-op scenario, Add post-op event) must be rewritten around events on the Procedure; S4 Beat 1 prepayment text touches US-03.1.8; S2 Beat 4 / S3 depend on the submit and authorise window staying consistent with the new until-AUTHORISED edit rule; S5 Beat 2 NHI validator narration fine but 'NHI pending' goes away. Presenter beats about the anaesthetist seeing no fee are unaffected but US-03.1.2 adds a pricing-basis line.

epics.title: Contracts
epics.observations:
EP-04 is a structural rewrite, not a patch. The prototype's billing identity is billingRoute (hospital/billableParty/insurer) + optional governingContractId + Type 1/2/3 Contracts + protected default Type 1 per hospital/insurer + ContractPrice rows keyed by RVG/surgeon/ordinal. The catalogue replaces this with Contract holders, dated Contract versions (header + stand-alone lines), settings flags (holder billed, anaesthetist can change price, prepaid, owner), one AA-held No contract (RVG) and a mandatory Contract per Procedure. Sizes overlap heavily: EP-04, FT-04.1/2/3, US-04.1.1, 04.2.1, 04.2.2, 04.2.4, 04.3.x are one coordinated domain/store/seed/UI rework (types.ts Contract/ContractPrice/Procedure, contracts.ts, fee.ts, invoiceBuild.ts, validateBookingForBilling.ts, contractActions.ts, mastersActions.ts default creation, seed contracts + bookings governingContractId, ContractEditSheet, EditBillingSetupSheet, bookingActions.ts additional-procedure contract copy, PERSIST_VERSION bump). Treat as one XL epic split into (1) model + billing maths, (2) catalogue/versioning/staging screens, (3) picker + booking setup.

Verifier changes: FT-04.1, US-04.2.14, US-04.3.2, US-04.3.4 moved Partial to Contradicts (implemented behaviour is wrong: hard delete, other anaesthetists' lists offered, mandatory reason, optional Contract with default fallback). The other 18 verdicts upheld. Only items left Partial: US-04.1.5, US-04.2.8, US-04.3.5. Missing: US-04.1.4, US-04.1.6.

Extra facts found: the seeded Doyle bariatric Contract (surgeon-held) on the hospital route bills the surgeon, opposite to the catalogue (surgeon arrangement bills the Booking's payer). The Method 3 permitsIndividualArrangement gate (rate x time lines) has no obvious catalogue equivalent; check EP-05 before removing it. The existing demo clock menu (shell/DemoClockMenu.tsx, demoClockShortcuts.ts) already lets the presenter advance to a date, so version-takes-effect beats need only a 'stage a price review' helper.

Dependencies: EP-11 / FT-11.2 / FT-11.4 (payer on Booking, insurer direct claims, OQ-114) decide who is billed once billing route goes; EP-05 (rate US-05.2.6, discount US-05.4.3, anaesthetist price change US-05.4.1, GST US-05.2.7); EP-03 (US-03.4.1 anaesthetist changes Contract, US-03.5.1, US-03.6.1 completion); EP-06 (prepaid flag starts prepayment, OQ-96, OQ-104); EP-08 (invoice description US-08.4.6, additional invoices US-08.6.4, credit note); EP-13 / US-04.2.13 upload (OQ-100). Open questions touching gradings: OQ-105, OQ-106, OQ-100, OQ-96, OQ-104, OQ-93, OQ-114, OQ-103.

Not graded (outside the 22): FT-04.4, US-04.2.3/5/6/7/9/12/13, US-04.3.6/7, US-04.4.x.

Demo-guide beats affected (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): billing Beat 1 (~442, resolves explicit payer and applies governing Contract), Beat 3 billing failure and retry (~560; relies on group-held Contract with no default fallback being dated out; 'Trigger billing failure' registry.ts ~364 and 'Resolve & retry' un-end-dates the Contract in BillingMonitorScreen.tsx:68-83), compliance Beat 4 contract effective-dating (~643; edits Health NZ Type 2 in place, must become a new dated version), plus Admin > Master data > Contracts click paths and 'default Type 1'/billing-route wording in 04-presenter-cheat-sheet.md (~37, 91, 113-119) and master-demo-guide.html. Seed canvas golden/fingerprint tests and seed.test.ts need updating when seed Contracts and the 36 governingContractId refs in seed/bookings.ts change.

epics.title: RVG master data and fee calculation rules
epics.observations: Prototype billing is the original-RFP model: Contract Type 1/2/3 lookups resolved at calc time (feeFor), a typed priceOverride with mandatory reason, ASA class seeding modifier units, modifiers kept on the first procedure, hourly rate x time billing lines, zero-total groups skipped, and view-only demo RVG (numeric codes, keyed by code) and modifier (19 codes) masters. Catalogue now has a Procedure-held price/rate/discount model (last change stands, no reason, Contract flag for anaesthetist, discount held as a fraction with own invoice line, no-charge invoice at $0, Contract version in force on the date, prepaid keeps its issued price). Verifier regrades: US-05.2.5, US-05.2.6, US-05.4.3 moved Partial to Contradicts (validator demands times on fixed price; removed hourly line still built; discount folded into unit rate); US-05.4.2 dropped the authorised-lock point (US-07.3.2 immutable after AUTHORISED is consistent). Cluster fixes: (1) one reshaped price model on Procedure covering FT-05.2, FT-05.4, US-05.2.5/2.6, US-05.4.1-4.3 (store, fee.ts, validator, invoiceBuild incl. discount line and $0 invoice, override UIs without reason, Contract flag from US-04.2.2, review flag, Contract versions US-04.2.10, prepaid price US-06.2.2); (2) modifier split above 4 in fee.ts/UnitsCard plus a 3-procedure seed (FT-05.3, US-05.3.1; primary selection is US-03.2.1); (3) master data: real NZSA RVG 2021 seed with H/S/T codes and duplicate-code rows (hidden key), 30-code RVG modifier table with multi-value units, Admin add/edit with audit, P1 shown selected at 0 and toggleable only on Neurosurgery and Spine codes, ASA pre-fill removed, age modifiers pre-applied from patient age (US-03.3.8; OQ-95, OQ-101 open); (4) US-05.5.2 depends on FT-03.7 pre-op events. Bump PERSIST_VERSION for seed/type shape changes. Demo-guide beats at risk: S3 billing beats (split-billing time-units-only additional procedure, two-funder Booking), Health NZ agreed-rate beat, S5 compliance tour (ASA edit seeding modifier units), 'demo-plausible modifier values' discovery point. No scheduled or automatic behaviour in this epic, so no demo triggers are needed; seeded scenarios (3-procedure 7-modifier-unit Booking, discount Contract, flag-off Contract, $0 price Booking) are the way to make the new ACs demoable. Verified Matches (US-05.2.1, US-05.3.5) both Agreed, re-checked against ACs. Open items OQ-12, OQ-95, OQ-101 remain unresolved and are graded against the text as written."

epics.title: Prepayment
epics.observations:
Prototype is the pre-October model throughout: category-based trigger (Billable Party + 'Pre-payment' + full/split), office 'Raise pre-procedure invoice' button on the unpaid-prepayment warning row, prePayment Invoice/BillingCase with an ACCREC+ACCPAY pair whose payable goes to the anaesthetist and is released on receipt (seed: Souter Fri 24 PM prepayment already disbursed 2026-07-16), and a billing run that nets the deposit off a BTM-derived fee. Verification changes: US-06.5.1 Missing to Contradicts (anaesthetist paid before the procedure, breaks AC1), US-06.5.4 Partial to Contradicts (payee stays the original anaesthetist after a move), US-06.5.3 Partial to Contradicts (estimated fee); US-06.3.1 organisation-payer point dropped (BillableParty is person-only). Only genuine Missing items: US-06.3.6 (letters) and US-06.5.2 (cancel refund).

Dependencies: (1) prepaid Contract flag plus Contract-line fixed prices (US-04.2.14, EP-04) must land first; trigger and amount depend on it. (2) Outgoing-invoice approval screen does not exist (US-06.3.1, US-06.3.6; EP-08/EP-09 area). (3) Ad hoc additional invoice and credit note by hand (US-08.6.3, US-08.6.5) do not exist; needed by US-06.4.1 and US-06.5.2. (4) Internal ledger/holding-account concept shared with EP-08 and EP-10 (payableRelease, paymentActions release-on-receipt must skip prepayment cases). (5) The same no-calculation rule applies to all fixed-price Contracts (FT-05). (6) OQ-96/97/116 (editable prepaid price, part credit, mixed-Booking deduction) and OQ-104 (price held on issued invoice), OQ-115 (refund route) unresolved; build assumptions in the catalogue. (7) US-06.5.4's patient email touches notifications. Seed change plus PERSIST_VERSION bump needed (seeded split deposit, disbursed prepay). Stale 'Phase 41 seam' payee-repoint comments in listMoveActions/slotActions should be removed.

Demo-script impact: docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md S4 Beat 1 (Annette Riley prepayment warning, Fri 24 Jul) and any S3 money beat mentioning the prepaid Booking's disbursement or a deposit-then-balance invoice change; the S1/S2 own-move line 'nothing about the patient's prepayment is recalculated' stays true. Warning-samples copy lists a 'prepaid procedure with no price' rule not yet built. Most gaps are demoable only via new buttons: approve-with-letter on admin invoices, a holding-account card, cancel-refund credit, authorise moving holding money to the anaesthetist, optional patient email on move.

epics.title: List approval workflow
epics.observations:
All 13 verdicts upheld; no regrades. Corrections were to supporting detail only (US-07.2.1, US-07.2.2, US-07.4.1). I read the code directly for this pass and read the map files only via targeted greps, as the reviewer did.

Cross-cutting gaps, in order of leverage:
1. Edit lock on SUBMITTED. Anaesthetist edits are refused in editRefusal (store/lifecycle.ts ~:72), BookingDetailBody canEdit, mobile ListDetailScreen:112, web ListDetailView:112, the SubmitListSheet copy (:110), lifecycle/capture tests and cheat-sheet lines :46, :60, :397. One guard change plus UI and copy closes EP-07, FT-07.2, US-07.2.1 and US-07.2.3. Correction to the reviewer: uncompleteBooking (reopen for amendment) already exists and is gated by the same editRefusal, so no new edit-after-submit path is needed. Two design calls remain. First, a reopened Booking leaves a SUBMITTED List with an incomplete Booking at authorise time. Second, whether the office should see a 'changed since submit' cue.
2. Review content (US-07.2.2) rests on the old billing-route model. domain-model.md now says each Procedure selects one Contract, with no route step. The Procedure still carries billingRoute and insurerId. There is no Booking-level payer, no insurer or approval number on the Booking, no text-as-received, no flag-for-office, and no child-as-payer or insurer-no-Contract warning rules. The warning registry holds only prepaymentUnpaid, and the demo registry (registry.ts:927) already stages samples for new rules. Depends on EP-04, US-11.2.2, US-11.2.4, US-11.4.3 and US-03.6.3.
3. Contract-version lock and snapshot at authorise (US-07.3.1) depend on US-04.3.5, since Contract has no versioning.
4. Balances next-day rule (selectors.ts:922; registry.ts:684) must go per 19 Oct Greg notes; this fixes FT-07.4 and US-07.4.1 together. Catalogue nit: US-07.4.1's screenshot caption 'The next day the new invoices appear' contradicts its own text.
5. Anaesthetist search (US-03.1.6) does not exist, which blocks FT-07.4, US-07.4.1 and US-07.4.2. Mobile main-view scroll-back is also missing: Week/Month start at today, and a past ACTIVE, all-complete, unsubmitted List is reachable nowhere.

Solid and matching: FT-07.1 (all pairing transitions), US-07.1.1, FT-07.3 and US-07.3.2. I found no write path that bypasses the AUTHORISED lock.

Demo-guide beats affected: S2 Beat 4 and S3 Beat 1 (review screen content; invoices-next-day messaging), the submit-sheet beat, cheat-sheet FAQ and state table (:46, :60, :397), and the 'Next morning' trigger copy. Triggers 'Office authorises this List' and the 'stage warning samples' action remain valid.

epics.title: Billing/Invoice Engine and internal ledger
epics.observations: Structural: no internal ledger (BillingCase + simulated Xero ACCREC/ACCPAY slices stand in; pair created in the Xero handoff after the run, and an armed handoff fault leaves an invoice with no pair), no prepay holding account, no credit-note/additional-invoice/event entities, no invoice description, no anaesthetist GST number. The old prepayment model (patientPaymentCategory=selfFundedPrepayment, deposit/estimated-fee pre-invoice raised by an office button, balance run deducts it, negativeTotal exception) conflicts with FT-08.1, US-08.2.2, FT-08.3 and US-08.3.1; rework with EP-06 (prepaid Contracts, FT-06.4 settlement, FT-06.5 holding account) and bump PERSIST_VERSION (now 25). Payer/route model (Procedure.billingRoute, default-contract fallback, no authorisation snapshot) overlaps EP-04 (US-04.3.5 snapshot, No contract (RVG)) and EP-11 (billable party); it is the root of the US-08.1.1 contradiction and a soft qualifier on US-08.2.1. Credit/additional-invoice/split stories (US-08.6.2 to 6.5) depend on each other, on events (FT-03.7, OQ-63) and on payables netting (US-10.2.5): build order 08.6.3 (additional invoice + event + next-run) then 08.6.5/08.6.2 (credit, negative payable) then 08.6.4. Matches: US-08.2.1 (grouping) and US-08.5.1 (per-Booking status and roll-up). Verifier change: FT-08.1 Partial to Contradicts (exception implemented on superseded model, no admin approve step); all other verdicts upheld. Demo guide beats affected (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): S3 Beat 1 (~427-445) and Beat 2 (~452-459) if pair/ledger or invoice wording change; S4 Beat 1 prepayment warning (~522) and S4 Beat 2 post-op addendum (~543-553, explicitly interim) replaced by the additional-invoice flow; S4 billing-failure beat (~561) if the expired-contract fallback is removed; payables beats (~584-589) if prepay payable goes to the holding account.

epics.title: Xero integration
epics.observations: Main gap is prepayment: no prepay holding account (US-06.5.1) and no second settlement pair (FT-06.4). FT-09.1, US-09.1.1 and US-09.1.3 all state the holding-account clause and all contradict; it is one body of work (US-09.1.3, L), not three. Paid prepayments currently authorise and disburse to the anaesthetist before the procedure. Cross-epic dependency on EP-06 (prepayment, settlement, refund on cancellation) and EP-08 (US-08.3.1 pair spec, US-08.4.5 GST agency). Touches handoffCase, receivePayment, payablesDue/disbursePayables (hold holding-account payables back), billingRun prepaid-balance logic (billingRun.ts:97), Xero sim and web Accounts mirror; PERSIST_VERSION bump if seed changes. US-09.2.4: depends on OQ-111, avoid building Xero payables-run detection until Greg answers. US-09.1.4 waits on OQ-29 (labelled placeholder only). Demo-guide beats affected (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): Beat 2 Xero collection and payable pair, part-then-balance payables-run beat, any prepayment beat showing payment reaching the anaesthetist. Statuses not used to scope work.

epics.title: Payments, disbursement and AA fees
epics.observations: Fee side (FT-10.3, US-10.3.1, US-10.3.3) is a complete Phase 16 build matching the current text and Greg's views (paid-only count, never netted, separate receivable, no payable, GST at foot). BCTI_COUNT_RULE.paidOnly is a one-switch rule, so OQ-60 answers are cheap to apply; OQ-112 (month end vs 20th) would change only the run label, the AaFeesScreen caption (line 150) and the demo-trigger name. Payable release (FT-10.2, US-10.2.1) matches, with unit tests. The one real gap is US-10.2.6: no approval state, no payment period and no weekly cycle exists (grep finds none), so build it with US-10.2.7 (week-scoped approval plus payables run) and OQ-47. OQ-111 (Xero pays vs new system) would change wording only, since the prototype already pays from the Admin run. Demo-guide beat 3 (payment, balances, disbursement, docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md ~464-476, 583-588) would need an approve step if US-10.2.6/10.2.7 are built; the AA fee beat is unaffected unless OQ-112 moves the run. Reviewer's grades all upheld on independent re-read; no evidence errors found. Cross-epic deps: EP-09 (ACCPAY draft creation, Xero handoff), US-05.2.7 (GST at foot of fee invoice), US-08.3.1 (matching payable), Phase 36 ledger pair for the fee invoice.

epics.title: Patients and billable parties
epics.observations: Structural gap: the prototype decides who is billed from a hand-set per-Procedure billingRoute (hospital/billableParty/insurer) plus patientPaymentCategory; the catalogue has the Contract (holder pays AA or not, No contract (RVG), no insurer default Contracts per US-04.3.3) decide, with the payer (name+email, default patient) on the Booking. FT-11.2, US-11.2.2/11.2.3, FT-11.4, US-11.4.1/11.4.2 depend on the EP-04 Contract/holder rework and should be sequenced after it. NHI cluster (US-11.1.1/11.1.4/11.1.5) is one piece of work: make Patient.nhi required, remove provisional patients (seed PT0010, 'NHI pending' labels in shared/format.ts, ReviewScreen, web ListDetailView, scenario link), add an unmatched/waiting-for-NHI queue (shared with US-02.1.4) with Add NHI and urgency by List date, and a 'no NHI' sample in the integrations/PDF simulator. Balance alerts (FT-11.3, US-11.3.2) should be rules on the existing warning registry (domain/warnings, one rule today; registry.ts:927 sample-warnings control already anticipates a balance rule) and share work with EP-13 (US-13.7.1) and US-11.3.1/11.3.3. Mitchell's seeded unpaid invoice (2026-04-14) is already 98 days old at DEMO_TODAY, giving a ready strong-alert case; a mild and a credit case need seeding. Reviewer was sound overall: all verdicts upheld; corrections were to individual points (dropped two non-defects on US-11.1.1; anaesthetist can pick an existing payer at Booking creation via ManualBookingForm; insurer picker hidden on billableParty route). OQ-114 (flag purpose) and OQ-93/OQ-98 (insurance indication, plain-RVG insurer Contracts) are open; graded against text as written. PERSIST_VERSION bump (13) needed for any seed shape change. Demo-guide beats affected: NHI/PDF validator beats (~L571-629), guardian/insured reimbursement/pre-payment beats (~L441-458) until routing becomes Contract-derived, cheat sheet section 11 'Prior balance' flag (04-presenter-cheat-sheet.md:367). Maps tie these gaps to catch-up phases 21 and 40.

epics.observations: Structural: Anaesthetist.gstPeriod (types.ts:215, cast.ts incl. Whitaker sixMonthly, fixtures.ts:24, admin Add/Edit/Record/AnaesthetistsView, audit fieldLabels.ts:154, GST_OPTIONS, web GstReport default) is retired by US-12.1.2; removing it touches a PERSIST_VERSION bump and the demo guide (any beat showing the GST period selector or Whitaker six-monthly). Out-of-scope neighbour that bears on FT-12.2: US-12.2.1 (Agreed, status 4) says flat owed list, no ageing buckets, no age chips, no Overdue view (OQ-59), yet web Overdue has ageing columns and mobile has AgeChip plus the dashboard aging panel; that should be graded Contradicts in its own run and is why FT-12.2 is Contradicts. Pairings admin-only and no prepaid on profile both match. Anaesthetists have no profile screen in mobile or web, but catalogue screenshots are admin-only, so accepted. Suggested single phase: remove gstPeriod, add bank fields, make GST report a monthly picker with download/print/email, drop ageing from owed list."}]

epics.title: Admin oversight and master data
epics.observations: Notification pool is the largest gap: FT-13.8, US-13.8.1, 13.8.2 and 13.8.3 all hinge on one change (resolve tick, active/resolved states, active count, show-resolved filter). It reverses the old OQ-79 'no read/clear state' recommendation baked into NOTIFICATION_POOL_RULE (actionable:false), the NotificationsCard/Screen comments and the provisional caption. Needs Notification.resolvedAt/By, an audited office-only resolve action, a seed with active and resolved notices, PERSIST_VERSION bump (currently 25), and ideally one shared tick affordance with the to-do's Clear. Extra notice sources (alert from List/Booking, US-03.6.3; optional notify on single Booking move, US-01.4.7/OQ-85) belong to EP-01/EP-03 work and should post through postNotification; the cover-change update email (US-02.3.3, Phase 35 note) hangs off a notice row. Warnings: engine and to-do are sound (FT-13.7, US-13.7.2 match); only 1 of 5 listed rules exists in US-13.7.1, the others depend on EP-03 (base-unit range), EP-11 (payer, balance threshold) and EP-07 (insurer Contract); each owning build should add its rule plus a warningSamples entry. Pairings: US-13.6.3 complete; US-13.6.4 needs a small domain change so preferred orders within tier (rankAnaesthetistCandidates sorts on tier only) plus test and demo-guide edits. Audit: payments, receipts, disbursements (xero.paymentReceived, xero.disbursed, aaFee.paymentRecorded) are audited and shown, which contradicts the carve-out in both FT-13.5 and US-13.5.2 (one fix, drop or filter them); credit-note audit arrives with EP-08. Sign-in (US-13.5.3, FT-13.5 proposal) deferred by OQ-83; a skippable simulated login is the cheapest demo. Master data (US-13.4.1): RVG and modifier editing, insurer add/edit, contract-holder record (US-04.1.5) and a master public holiday calendar are missing; US-13.4.3 cutover load has only Reset. Demo-script impact (docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md): lines ~277, 296, 374 say preferred is marked and shuffled within tier (change if preferred lifts order); the notification beat (~341 to 364) says notices are not to-dos and describes busy-morning paging, which changes when notices can be ticked and hidden; any sign-in screen must be skippable so S1 to S5 still start straight in. Verifier changes: FT-13.5 Partial to Contradicts (consistency with US-13.5.2 carve-out); US-13.4.1 size M to L and one weak point dropped; US-13.8.2 surfaces trimmed. All Agreed-status Matches (US-13.1.1, US-13.6.3, US-13.7.2) re-checked against code and upheld.

OQ-109 (unresolved) affects FT-02.1, US-02.1.5, EP-14, FT-14.6, US-14.3.1: the answer decides whether the first release auto-syncs St George's and Southern Cross. Existing HL7/FHIR surfaces (Admin Integrations, /demo/integrations, fire/replay triggers) are old-RFP-style intake badged Future scope; may need reframing as Future Work lane plus a per-hospital transport config matrix if children grade it. Scripted beats S1 and S4 (dead-letter) use this simulator, so relabelling would touch docs/demo-guide/03-demo-script.md. The DemoIntegrations futureScope copy claims a matching-screen download is in scope today but no matching screen exists in the prototype. Epic itself needs no code change.

epics.title: Non-functional requirements
epics.observations: All four EP-15 items are cross-cutting and Proposed. Gaps map onto existing plan phases (all unbuilt): 43 (scale and privacy: in-memory full-scale dataset with timings, restricted raw-payload view, NHI leak scan, synthetic-data badge) for US-15.0.4 and US-15.0.6; 43a (sign-in, ease of use, point-of-need help, first-run hint) for US-15.0.1. US-15.0.2 Matches; web document download/email/print belongs to US-03.1.4 and US-12.2.2. Cross-item tension: US-15.0.1's Note ("anaesthetists see none of the Contract complexity") is Proposed and now yields to Confirmed US-03.1.2 and US-03.1.9, which require the Contract on anaesthetist screens; the prototype currently shows route chip plus Contract/insurer/payer context to anaesthetists, so 43a must keep the Contract but can drop the route chip. A scale loader must bypass persistence (5 MB budget), so no PERSIST_VERSION bump is needed. The raw-payload view ties to US-14.5.1 (dead-lettered HL7) and US-09.3.1 (already matches). Demo-guide impact: Xero beat and integration dead-letter beat gain a restricted-raw-view step; a scale beat would be new. A synthetic-data badge touches the shell harness bar and the PWA More tab.

items.summary: Core Xero mirror (ACCREC + draft ACCPAY pair, webhook + daily poll, hidden-ID contacts, archiving) is built; the epic's resilience and divergence discussion (async queue, auto-retry with backoff, alerting, Xero-side void/amend drift) is not represented.
items.requirement_says: Dedicated Xero org under the engine (not system of record) mirrors an ACCREC and draft ACCPAY per ledger pair, detects payment by webhook plus daily poll, uses hidden-ID contacts. Proposed resilience: async processing, durable queue with exponential-backoff retry, idempotency, handling of engine/Xero divergence (voided/amended in Xero, payment against a credited invoice), failure/recovery testing.
items.prototype_does: Handoff is synchronous inside one mutate after the billing run. A single armed fault (settings.failNextHandoff) records handoffFailure on the case, shown in Billing Monitor with a manual 'Resolve & retry'. Webhook and poll are simulated. No queue, no automatic retry/backoff, no outage or alerting, no drift detection. XeroAccRec 'voided' is typed and rendered but nothing ever sets it. Idempotency is present (accRecId no-op, per-payment key).
missing_or_wrong: No Xero outage / slow-API simulation showing the user flow unblocked while events queue
No automatic retry with exponential backoff, retry count or next-attempt visibility (manual Resolve & retry only)
No alerting of persistent handoff failure beyond the Billing Monitor chip
No divergence handling: an invoice voided/amended directly in Xero is never detected; no payment-against-credited-invoice ordering case
'voided' ACCREC status exists in types/UI but is never driven
Epic frames the engine ledger as system of record (US-08.3.2); prototype has no internal ledger, BillingCase + XeroAccRec/AccPay hold the money (dependency on EP-08)
evidence: searched: backoff|outage|queue|nextAttempt in src/store and src/apps/demo -> only integration (HL7) retry, none for Xero
items.demo_trigger: Button 'Simulate Xero outage' on the Xero sim (/demo/xero) and on /demo/control: while on, new handoffs and payment syncs go into a visible pending queue showing attempt count and backoff timer, while the user flow (authorise a List) continues unblocked. 'Restore Xero' drains the queue and pairs appear with no duplicates. Plus 'Void this invoice in Xero' on the pair detail so the next poll flags the mismatch for office resolution. Shell has no screen-contextual slot for these today, so they live on the Xero sim pair detail / control panel.
items.verify_note: Re-searched store and demo for queue/backoff/retry/void handling: only manual handoff retry exists; 'voided' has a label render but no writer. Verdict upheld. Added the system-of-record/ledger dependency point.
items.title: Xero integration

items.summary: ACCREC + DRAFT ACCPAY pair created atomically with IDs linked is built, but a prepayment's ACCPAY goes to the anaesthetist, not the prepay holding account the feature body now requires.
items.requirement_says: For each ledger pair the engine creates an ACCREC to the billable party and a draft ACCPAY to the anaesthetist (to the prepay holding account for a prepayment invoice) together in one transaction, linking them via returned Xero IDs. Billing state is tracked per invoice so partial runs are resumable and visible.
items.prototype_does: handoffCase creates ACCREC + DRAFT ACCPAY in one mutate and stores accRecId/accPayId on the BillingCase. A fault creates neither and is recorded per case; the Billing monitor shows per-Booking status with Resolve & retry. ACCPAY payee is always the anaesthetist from the Booking's List, including for pre-payment cases (raisePreProcedureInvoice calls handoffCasesForBooking). No holding-account contact, no second settlement pair.
missing_or_wrong: Prepayment ACCPAY must go to the prepay holding account; prototype pays the anaesthetist (xeroHandoff.ts:194-221)
No holding-account Xero contact and no second holding-to-anaesthetist pair at List authorisation (see US-09.1.3)
No separate 'ledger pair' entity: pair hangs off BillingCase (acceptable for demo, not a gap)
evidence: searched: prepay.*holding|holding account|holding contact in src -> none (only slot 'holding' hits, unrelated)
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Arm handoff failure + Resolve & retry (Billing monitor) cover partial runs. For the prepayment pair no new button; Xero sim Invoices tab should show payee 'Prepay holding account' (see US-09.1.3).
items.verify_note: Re-read handoffCase: payeeSpec = anaesthetistContactSpec(anaesthetist) with no prepayment branch; grep for holding account finds nothing relevant. Atomicity and per-case fault tracking confirmed. Size is shared with US-09.1.3 (one piece of work).

items.prototype_does: handoffCase builds both records in one mutate and sets accRecId/accPayId on the case. ACCREC InvoiceNumber = engine number, ACCPAY = number + '-P' (matches US-08.4.3), Reference = case reference on both. DemoXero and Admin Invoice show both identifiers and IDs. items.summary: Simulated Xero payment webhook matched by stored accRecId, authorising the ACCPAY for the full or exact amount received (min(received, payable)), idempotent, with demo triggers.
items.requirement_says: On an invoice webhook the engine fetches the invoice, checks it for payment, finds the ledger record by stored Xero ID, and authorises the linked ACCPAY in full or for exactly the amount received, so it is eligible for the next payables run without waiting for the daily poll.
items.prototype_does: receivePayment (source 'webhook') finds the case by accRecId, bumps ACCREC received/status, authorises the ACCPAY to payableReleasedFor(newReceived, payable) = min(received, payable), mirrors to case, idempotent by key; payables due then picks it up. Triggers 'Payment received full/half' and 'Replay last payment event' exist. Fetch/check steps are implicit in the call.
items.demo_trigger: Existing: Demo actions > Payment received full / half / Replay last payment event (Admin invoice page and /demo/xero/invoices/:id).
items.verify_note: Checked exact-amount rule (cumulative min, not proportional) and idempotency; no acceptance criteria beyond body. Prepayment interaction is handled under US-09.1.3.

items.summary: Reconciliation poll is wired to each day advance and has a manual button; it re-detects Xero payments the engine has not mirrored. The proposed drift check (voided/amended invoices) is a technical-discussion extension with policy TBC, carried on EP-09.
items.requirement_says: Each day the engine polls Xero for paid invoices to catch missed webhooks. Technical discussion (proposed, policy TBC): also confirm authorised invoices still match what the engine issued.
items.prototype_does: runReconciliationPoll runs on dayAdvanced (main.tsx wiring) and applies any PaymentIn with no matching receipt via receivePayment source poll, backdated to the payment date; seeded missed-webhook payment (oa02) is caught on the next day advance; 'Run reconciliation poll' on the control panel.

Optional: 'Record payment in Xero without webhook' on the Xero sim pair detail so the safety net can be re-demoed after the single seeded miss is consumed; catalogue screenshot shows the poll as a simulator panel, currently control panel only.
items.verify_note: Confirmed wiring and backdating. Drift check is explicitly proposed with TBC policy, so not held against the story; tracked in EP-09. Optional re-demo button is polish, not a gap. Size left None.

items.summary: Webhook and poll share one handler and a replayed event has no further effect. The dedupe key is a per-payment idempotency key rather than InvoiceID, which behaves correctly for partial payments.

items.prototype_does: receivePayment serves both paths; a receipt with the same idempotencyKey returns applied:false. 'Replay last event' shows 'Duplicate webhook ignored'. The poll skips payments whose key is already mirrored (webhook-created PaymentIn shares the key).

items.summary: ContactNumber carries the hidden internal ID, ContactID is cached, NHI never crosses. But the Xero contact Name holds the patient's real name, against 'rather than by name' and the confirmed OQ-30 answer 'No PII in Xero'. Sim callout still calls the NHI question unresolved.
items.requirement_says: Identify each billing contact to Xero by a hidden internal ID in ContactNumber, rather than by name or NHI. Cache the returned ContactID so later invoices look the contact up directly. NHI never goes to Xero in any field; per OQ-30 answer, no personal information goes into Xero, only a unique linking ID. But the created XeroContact has name = masters.patients[id].name (and billable party name); the Contacts tab, pair list 'Payer' column, ACCREC card 'Payer', and money-flow card all show that name. summary_md:
### Headline

The prototype is the July RFP model with Phases 15 to 32 layered on. Calendar, Slots, Lists, Draft Lists, pairings, tiers, warnings engine, the AA fee run and the Xero simulation are close to the catalogue. Money and intake are not. Of roughly 235 graded items, about 40 Match, about 25 are Partial, about 15 are Missing, and the rest are Contradicts or Grouping. Contradicts dominates EP-02 to EP-08, EP-11 and EP-12: the prototype implements a different, superseded design there, not a smaller version of the new one. EP-01, EP-10 and most of EP-13 are near done. The core is one coordinated rework: Contract (holder, dated versions, lines, flags) replaces billing route plus Type 1/2/3. Pricing, completion, prepayment, invoicing, payer, review and events all hang off it. Statuses were not used to scope work; they appear below only where an open question (OQ) makes a gap unsafe.

### Themes

**1. Contract-centred billing (XL).** Billing route, optional governing Contract, Type 1/2/3 and protected default Type 1s go. In: holders with an is-billed flag, dated Contract versions with AA code, standalone lines, one AA-held No contract (RVG), mandatory Contract per Procedure, staged review and submit, authorisation snapshot, filtered picker, anaesthetist may change Contract until AUTHORISED. Items: EP-04, FT-04.1 to 04.3, US-04.1.1 to 04.1.6, US-04.2.x, US-04.3.x, FT-03.4, US-03.4.1, US-08.1.1, US-07.3.1. DM-07, DM-09, DM-10, DM-48, DM-49, DM-57, DM-08, DM-16. RV-06, RV-11, RV-18, RV-32. Split into model and maths, versioning and staging screens, picker and booking setup.

**2. Pricing, units and modifiers (XL).** Price, rate and discount become values on the Procedure; no mandatory reason; Contract flag gates the anaesthetist; $0 gives a no-charge invoice; discount is its own invoice line; modifier units split above four; RVG becomes a hidden-key master (NZSA 2021, duplicate codes); modifiers become records with explanations, age pre-applied, ASA ordinary; out-of-range warns instead of blocking; completion rules reworked ("finish", not "handover"). Items: FT-05.1 to 05.4, US-05.x, FT-03.3, FT-03.5, US-03.3.x, US-03.5.x, US-03.6.1. DM-13, DM-43, DM-44, DM-50, DM-14, DM-15, DM-46. RV-03, RV-04, RV-07 to RV-10, RV-21, RV-22, RV-38. Many S quick wins (NHI, wording, reason removal, make-primary).

**3. Hospital intake matching screen (XL).** Nothing exists: HL7/FHIR and PDF rows apply straight to Bookings. Needed: staged rows, match/create/Draft List/assign/reject, per-row change type, field differences for approval, unmatched queue, day move as cancel plus new, edits allowed until AUTHORISED, third feed (CPH) out of scope. Items: EP-02, FT-02.1, FT-02.5, US-02.1.1/2/4/5, US-02.5.7, US-02.3.1, EP-14 (boundary). DM-34, DM-51. RV-12 to RV-16.

**4. NHI mandatory and source text (M, tied to 3).** Remove provisional patients and "NHI pending"; waiting-for-NHI queue with urgency; text exactly as received per source plus a separate invoice description. Items: US-11.1.1, US-11.1.4, US-11.1.5, US-03.1.5, US-03.1.9, US-08.4.6. DM-30, DM-51. RV-20.

**5. Prepayment and holding account (XL).** Trigger is a prepaid Contract, amount is the line price, admin approval plus letter, payable to a holding account, second pair at authorise, refund on cancel, no automatic balance. Today the anaesthetist is paid before the procedure. Items: EP-06, FT-06.2 to 06.5, US-06.x, FT-08.1, FT-08.3, US-08.2.2, US-08.3.1, FT-09.1, US-09.1.1, US-09.1.3. DM-20, DM-21, DM-22. RV-05, RV-24.

**6. Events, additional invoices, credit notes (XL).** Post-op addendum Booking is replaced by events on the Procedure, additional free-form invoices, credit-in-full-then-rebill, negative payables netted in a weekly cycle. Items: FT-03.7, US-03.7.x, US-05.5.2, FT-08.6, US-08.6.1 to 08.6.5, US-10.2.6. DM-17, DM-18, DM-24, DM-25. RV-23.

**7. Edit window and anaesthetist views (M).** Anaesthetist edits stay open on SUBMITTED; a List leaves the main view at AUTHORISED (not billed); balances show invoices immediately; search by name/NHI/date; scroll back. dataModelDeltas.title: The RVG group becomes the one master list (hidden key, type-ahead rows, modifier units, AA groups); there is no procedure list
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Base units sit on the RVG group: the NZSA RVG as published plus AA's own groups (not marked as AA-sourced), each with a code, description, anatomy heading, base units always set and above 0, and modifier units default 0. RVG codes are not unique enough to be keys, so a row has a hidden key and the same code can appear on several rows with different values. The RVG groups are the one master list: there is no procedure list, no body-section picker and no general procedure (OQ-88 answered; US-05.1.6 Retired). The anaesthetist picks the code by type-ahead showing code, short description and base units. The RVG code on a Procedure is optional, and the 'procedure' on a Booking is the text received. Seeded once from spreadsheets, then maintained by hand with every change audited. Open: the system code (US-05.1.1 note), how a published unit range is held (OQ-101), whether the anatomy heading is used to browse (US-05.1.3, Verify).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Only RvgCode (types.ts:919), keyed by its code string: code, description, an anatomicalSite string, baseUnits single or range, absorbsModifierCodes; 33 demo rows (seed/rvgCodes.ts:13). Procedure.rvgBaseCode (types.ts:870) is a scalar string into that table, and the validator requires one unless a billing line exists (validateBookingForBilling.ts:130). No hidden key, no duplicate-code rows, no modifier units on the group, no AA-added groups, no type-ahead that shows base units.

dataModelDeltas.title: The contract holder becomes a master record (insurer, hospital, surgeon or rooms, anaesthetist; AA holds No contract) with an is-billed flag, a billable party and a practitioner link
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Every Contract belongs to a contract holder: an insurer, a hospital, a surgeon or a surgeon's rooms, or an anaesthetist (own price list). AA itself holds No contract (RVG). 'First party' and 'third party' are dropped. Each holder records whether AA invoices it (then its billable party record is required and billed) or it only sets the price (the Booking's payer is billed), and optionally the anaesthetist or surgeon its Contracts belong to, so they are offered only on that person's Bookings. A holder can hold many Contracts. The office creates anaesthetists' holders and Contracts from the price list the anaesthetist supplies (US-04.1.5, US-04.2.1, US-04.2.14, OQ-91). Open: what the insurer's accepts-direct-claims flag now means (OQ-114), how a surgeon's fixed-price arrangement is found for a Booking (OQ-105).

Contract carries holderType 'hospital' | 'insurer' | 'surgeon' | 'organisation' | 'billableParty' plus holderId into four disjoint tables (types.ts:367, :388; ContractHolderOrganisation types.ts:352), and ContractScope individualAnaesthetist (types.ts:379) is the only first-party idea. There is no is-billed flag: the holder is always the counterparty on the contract-holder route (invoiceBuild.ts:192). Insurer.acceptsDirectClaims (types.ts:345) gates the Insurer route only.

dataModelDeltas.title: The Contract becomes a series of dated versions with an AA code and behaviour flags; Type 1/2/3, scope, the default per holder and the Method 3 gate go
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Contract is a structure that sets how a procedure is paid for and who pays; there are no kinds or categories. Each Contract is a series of dated versions (start, optional end, a review date, a forward link to the version that revised it) and all its lines share the dates. Every change, a correction or a renewal, creates a new version from a date the office chooses (never past, never backdated, nothing deleted); the previous version ends the day before; only one future-dated version at a time, freely corrected or withdrawn until it starts; the version in force on the procedure date prices the Procedure. On submit, un-invoiced Procedures dated on or after the new start are relinked to the new version's line with the same line key, unmatched ones are listed, and a prepaid Procedure keeps its invoiced price (OQ-104). Every Contract has a unique short AA code (format OQ-66), searchable with holder codes. Behaviour comes from flags AA sets: the holder is billed (on the holder), editable (may the anaesthetist change price, rate or discount; OQ-107), prepaid, and default (No contract (RVG)), plus invoice layout, delivery method and GST treatment (US-04.1.1 to US-04.1.4, US-04.2.2, US-04.2.8, US-04.2.10). Anaesthetists never edit Contracts.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Contract (types.ts:388): type 1 | 2 | 3, holderType and holderId, scope, permitsIndividualArrangement, isDefault, effectiveFromISO and effectiveToISO, type2Detail. No version link, review date, AA code, editable flag or prepaid flag; contractActions.ts edits in place with audit entries only. Effectiveness is judged on the List date at billing time (contracts.ts:22) and selection ranks individual over organisational over default (contracts.ts:34). The seed holds 12 Contracts (seed/contracts.ts:45).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Schema rewrite of the master that pricing, billing and the review screens read (26 non-test files touch governingContractId or billingRoute, 10 touch holderType). Needs DM-48 and DM-09 in the same step. The rank-based selectContract is replaced by the filtered picker of DM-10. The editable flag drives DM-14 and the prepaid flag drives DM-20. A new version needs a copy-lines action, an overlap guard and the relink on submit; staged review is DM-57. Seed Contracts are re-authored.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Contract interface has no version, AA code, editable or prepaid field; seed has 12 contracts (6 defaults + others).

dataModelDeltas.title: The Contract line (standalone, carrying only what it sets, with a system line key) replaces ContractPrice
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Contract has lines, or none (a hospital's plain RVG Contract has none). A line stands alone: no nesting, no procedure link, and several lines may share a default RVG code; a combination (for example 'Facelift plus 1 add on') is a line of its own. A line carries only what it sets: a system line key (never reused, kept when a new version copies the line), an optional holder reference code unique within the Contract and searchable, a description that starts the invoice description, an optional default RVG code, and any of a fixed price (ex GST), a rate, a discount, or base or modifier units. Blank means not set and 0 is a value. Removed: procedure link, RVG mapping, time band, add-on flag, quantity rule, price tier and line-level dates (US-04.2.4, US-04.2.11, US-04.2.2, US-05.2.5, US-05.2.6, US-05.4.3; OQ-89).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: ContractPrice (types.ts:422): contractId, optional rvgBaseCode, surgeonId, procedureOrdinal, price. Only Type 3 Contracts use rows, matched most-specific-wins (contracts.ts:77) with a BTM fallback. Rate and discount live on Contract.type2Detail (types.ts:384), not on a line. No line key, reference code, description, default RVG code or units override.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Replaces masters.contractPrices and matchContractPrice (14 non-test files). Surgeon-specific and ordinal-specific prices are re-expressed as surgeon-held Contracts and plain lines. The picker (DM-10), the unit resolver (DM-43) and pricing (DM-50) read lines, and a Procedure points to a line. Seed prices and Master Data screens are rewritten. After DM-13 and DM-07.

dataModelDeltas.title: One stored No contract (RVG), held by AA and never billed, replaces the protected default Type 1 per hospital and direct-billing insurer
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Exactly one No contract (RVG): held by AA (a holder that is never billed), no practice-wide prices, never expires, found by a flag and not its name, offered first for every procedure, billing the payer on the Booking. There are no hospital, insurer or per-procedure default Contracts and nothing is derived from the List's location. A holder's plain RVG Contract with no lines is an ordinary Contract offered by context (OQ-98). Routine procedures as lines of No contract (RVG) are a possible later option (OQ-106). The default-Contract feature is Retired (US-04.3.3, FT-04.4, US-04.4.1, US-04.4.2; OQ-78).

dataModelDeltas.title: Each Procedure selects one Contract and, where it has lines, one line at booking setup; the billing route and billing-time Contract resolution disappear
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Every Procedure references exactly one Contract (and, where the Contract has lines, one line) before its Booking can be marked complete. The office sets it at booking setup, its main job being to identify who pays (holder, then Contract, then line); a Booking without a Contract stays on the admin's list, and the RVG code or line may be left blank for the anaesthetist (OQ-99). The anaesthetist may change the Contract, line and RVG code until the List is AUTHORISED, with no reason; every change is audited and flagged at office review; changing the Contract resets price, rate, discount and starting units. The picker lists Contracts, not lines: No contract (RVG) first, then the hospital's, then surgeons' and anaesthetists' arrangements, valid on the procedure date and whose holder fits the Booking, with RVG-code reverse lookup and AA or holder code search. The engine resolves no route or payer; the Contract does (US-04.3.1, US-04.3.2, US-04.3.4, US-03.4.1, FT-03.4, FT-04.3, US-08.1.1).

dataModelDeltas.title: Starting units come from the Contract line, then the RVG group, and become the Procedure's own values; any value is accepted and an out-of-range one only warns
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Choosing the Contract (and line) and the RVG code fills in the Procedure's starting values: base units from the RVG code, or from the line where the line states its own; modifier units from 0 plus any modifier the system applies; any price, rate or discount from the line. From then on they are the Procedure's own values, which the anaesthetist may change to any figure, including one outside the published range; that raises an after-procedure warning for the office and never blocks. Changing the Contract resets them. The RVG code is optional (not needed on a fixed price). There is no procedure layer and no source layer is recorded (US-03.3.1, FT-05.2, US-05.1.1, US-04.2.2, US-13.7.1; OQ-56, OQ-101).

dataModelDeltas.title: Pricing is one rule on values held on the Procedure: its price, else (base + time + modifier) x rate x (1 - discount); Type 2/3 pricing goes
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Procedure is priced by its Contract and the values held on the Procedure itself (Donald, 18 October; the documents' ordered price steps are not adopted). If the Procedure holds a price (a fixed price from its line, the prepaid amount, or one entered by someone permitted) that is the price and BTM is kept for reference. Otherwise the price is (B + T + M) x rate x (1 - discount): the rate is the line's rate, else the anaesthetist's own unit value; the discount is the one held on the Procedure, shown as its own invoice line. A price of 0 gives a no-charge invoice; BTM is optional on a fixed price and required on a fixed-rate Contract. Prices use the Contract version in force on the procedure date; submission is rejected when no price can be worked out; every price is held ex GST (FT-05.2, US-05.2.1, US-05.2.5, US-05.2.6, US-05.4.3, US-05.2.7, US-03.5.2).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: feeFor (fee.ts:180): Type 1 units x unit value; Type 2 an agreed unit rate or a percent discount folded into a derived rate; Type 3 a fixed ContractPrice else a BTM fallback (the ordinal rule at fee.ts:212); non-RVG billing lines (fee.ts:237); then the typed priceOverride last (types.ts:880). Price, rate and discount are not held on the Procedure and nothing records a price source.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Rewrite of the pure fee path and its Vitest suite on the new Procedure values (price, rate, discount) with a rejection path; Procedure gains those three fields, filled from the line. Invoice line text must stop being the only snapshot (DM-08). Depends on DM-09 and DM-14.
