dataModelDeltas.title: Price changes become edits of the Procedure's own price, rate and discount: the anaesthetist where the Contract is editable, the office on any Contract, no reason, last change stands
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The Contract carries a flag, set by AA, saying whether the anaesthetist may change price, rate or discount (typically yes on RVG-priced Contracts, no on a hospital's fixed-price Contract or a surgeon's fixed fee, where no discount may be added either; a prepaid Procedure is OQ-96). Where not allowed, the price is read-only and they change the Contract or ask the office. The office can change any price, rate or discount on any Contract at any time. No reason is needed (US-03.5.3 Retired; only a claimed modifier needs an explanation); every change is audited and flagged at office review, and the last change stands, neither side outranking the other. Changing the Contract resets the values. BTM is still recorded in full (US-03.5.1, US-03.5.2, US-05.4.1, US-05.4.2, FT-03.5, FT-05.4; OQ-107 answered).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: One optional Procedure.priceOverride of fixedFee, dollarAdjustment or percentAdjustment with a mandatory reason (types.ts:812, :880), writable by anyone with edit rights through editProcedure (lifecycle.ts:452); OverrideCard and PriceOverrideSheet drive it. No Contract editable flag, no actor distinction, no reset on a Contract change, no review flag.
dataModelDeltas.impact: priceOverride and its reason go; the Procedure's price, rate and discount (DM-50) are edited in place with the actor audited; validator and both UIs gate on the Contract's editable flag; audit labels and the review flag change. 9 non-test files read priceOverride. Price change on a prepaid Procedure is OQ-96. Depends on DM-07 and DM-10.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: PriceOverride type with mandatory reason confirmed; US-03.5.3 Retired is the boundary.

dataModelDeltas.title: Modifiers become per-Procedure records, each claimed one with an explanation; age and included modifiers are pre-applied but not locked; ASA is just a modifier
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The anaesthetist picks each modifier that applies from the RVG modifier table plus AA's own, itemised, and gives a short explanation for each claimed one (the only explanation the system asks for). The system pre-applies only the age modifier (A1 or A2, from the patient's date of birth) and any modifier already included in a code's base units (P1 on every Neurosurgery code H7A to H9b and Spine code S1 to S10), shown selected at 0 units; none is locked and the anaesthetist can remove any (Donald, 20 October). Nothing is pre-filled from ASA, which is one of the optional modifiers. Some modifier values are not plain numbers. Whether any is applied at all is OQ-95 (US-03.3.4, US-03.3.8, US-05.1.4, US-05.1.5, FT-03.3; US-03.3.5 Itemise modifiers is Retired, merged into US-03.3.4).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Procedure.selectedModifierCodes (string array, types.ts:868) plus a separate asaClass (types.ts:866) that seeds its AS code (fee.ts:79); modifierUnits sums plain numbers and zeroes any code in RvgCode.absorbsModifierCodes with a refusal caption (modifierUnits.ts:58). No explanation field, no date-of-birth age modifier, no per-Procedure modifier record.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New record (procedure, modifier, units, explanation, origin: chosen, age or included); the modifier master gains non-numeric value shapes and AA's own codes; the RVG group's included link replaces absorbsModifierCodes; asaClass and the refusal path go; completion blockers add the explanation rule; the capture sheet is rebuilt. 13 non-test files read selectedModifierCodes or asaClass. Needs DM-13; feeds DM-15.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: asaClass and selectedModifierCodes confirmed; the locked versus not-locked contradiction in US-03.3.4 is recorded in the delta file's contradiction list.

dataModelDeltas.title: Multi-procedure rule: one primary flag, time on every procedure, modifier units split above four, no Contract-specific ordinals
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Every Booking has exactly one primary Procedure, set by anyone with edit rights. Base units only on the primary. Time units on every Procedure from its own start and finish times (1 per 15 minutes for two hours, then 1 per 10; a part interval rounded up; the tiers held as data). Modifier units all on the primary while the Booking's total is 4 or fewer, otherwise divided as evenly as possible across all Procedures with the remainder to the primary (7 over 3 is 3, 2, 2). No Contract changes the rule: Contract-specific second-procedure rules are Retired (US-03.2.1, US-03.2.2, US-05.3.1, US-05.2.2; US-04.2.5 and US-05.3.4 Retired; OQ-90 answered).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: The base-on-primary and time-on-every-procedure parts already match (an additional procedure yields time units only). What differs: Procedure.isAdditional is a boolean on added procedures (types.ts:863) with modifiers always on the first (fee.ts:107 splitBillingUnits); no settable primary and no modifier split above four; ordinal-keyed fixed prices (ContractPrice.procedureOrdinal; fee.ts:212); time tiers are module constants (timeUnits.ts:13).
dataModelDeltas.impact: isAdditional becomes isPrimary (15 non-test files); the allocation step is pure and testable; ordinal pricing and its seed rows go; tiers become data. Needs DM-44 for the modifier total.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: splitBillingUnits returns time units only for isAdditional (fee.ts:107); no modifier split present.

dataModelDeltas.title: The BillingLine entity, rate x time billing and the Method 3 gate are removed; other late lines become events
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Rate x time capture is Retired (US-03.3.7): a Contract with its own fixed rate prices the whole Procedure at BTM x that rate (US-05.2.6), not a billing line. 'Other billing lines' (post-op reviews, nerve catheters, pain consults, transport) are Retired as a concept (US-03.3.6) and merged into events (FT-03.7, DM-17). Contract add-on fees are gone (US-04.2.4). Time is an optional recording only (OQ-89). A split between payers is a Booking action, not a line setting (DM-28).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: BillingLine with ChargeBasis 'rvg' | 'fixed' | 'rateTime' (types.ts:888, :897), hours and rate, and funderOverride; Contract.permitsIndividualArrangement as the Method 3 gate, validator-enforced (validateBookingForBilling.ts:222); the seeded rate x time capture Booking (Souter); lines summed into the fee (fee.ts:237); the add-line UI (shared/capture/AddBillingLineSheet.tsx, BillingLinesCard.tsx).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Wider than the earlier reading: the whole BillingLine entity (25 non-test files touch BillingLine, billingLines or chargeBasis) is replaced by events (DM-17) and the Procedure's price. Delete the rateTime basis, the gate field, the validator branch, the seeded scenario and the UI. Build DM-17 first, then remove; do with DM-07 so the Contract shape is touched once.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-03.3.6 and US-03.3.7 Retired confirmed; Method 3 gate at validator :222.

dataModelDeltas.title: Authorising a List snapshots each Procedure's Contract version, line and pricing values; the billing engine reads the snapshot
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: On AUTHORISED the engine snapshots, per Procedure, the Contract version (each version its own record), the values on the Procedure (units, price, rate, discount), the recorded BTM, the rate and discount used, the price, and the payer or billable party details. Later changes to RVG groups or Contracts never alter an issued invoice, which can always be reproduced. The engine resolves no route or payer. Before authorisation, where the Contract was revised after the Booking was made, values refresh from the revised line (a prepaid Procedure keeps its invoiced price); how that relinking meets a Procedure locked at authorisation is not stated (US-04.2.10 note) (US-04.3.5, US-07.3.1, US-07.3.2, US-08.4.4, US-08.1.1, US-05.3.5).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: authoriseList (lifecycle.ts:275) only sets the List to AUTHORISED. The billing run later resolves the Contract and computes the fee at run time (invoiceBuild.ts:114, :264; billingRun.ts:69) and stores amounts plus rate text inside invoice line descriptions (invoiceBuild.ts describeFeeLine :247). No stored Contract version or resolved values. InvoiceLine.procedureId is optional (types.ts:1131), so the per-Procedure ledger share of US-05.3.5 is not recorded.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New PricingSnapshot record per Procedure, written at authorisation and read by the run and by invoice regeneration, carrying the per-Procedure units and dollars; the immutable lock now covers the Contract version as well as the Booking. Needs DM-07, DM-10, DM-50 and DM-11. The existing per-Booking failure isolation (billingRun.ts:69) stays.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Contract resolved at run time confirmed; InvoiceLine.procedureId optional confirmed.

dataModelDeltas.title: The Contract carries invoice layout, delivery method, GST treatment and the holder references a Booking must supply
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A Contract sets the invoice layout (holder or patient; the holder's carries the BTM breakdown), the delivery method (email, or portal upload for a direct insurer) and the GST treatment (US-04.2.8). It also names the references its holder needs on invoices (an insurer member number, the holder's own reference such as SXAP); the office supplies them on the Booking, not the anaesthetist (US-04.2.2, US-11.4.3). The configurable required booking inputs are Retired (US-04.2.7). No invoice email sits on the Contract.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Layout is derived from the counterparty kind at build time (layoutFor, invoiceBuild.ts:216; Invoice.layout types.ts:1119). A single free-text Procedure.billingReference (hospital approval reference) with its completeness check (validateBookingForBilling.ts:49). No delivery-method field; emailing is a stamp (billingRun.ts:411).
dataModelDeltas.impact: A few Contract fields and a Booking-side reference map keyed by the references the Contract names; the completeness check moves to office review. Depends on DM-07.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Email stamp is at billingRun.ts:411 (emailedAtISO), not :399; substance upheld.

dataModelDeltas.title: Each Procedure keeps the text exactly as received from each source, the rooms' and the hospital's apart, plus a separate invoice description
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Each Procedure keeps the procedure text exactly as each originating system sent it: the surgeon's rooms' description and, separately, the hospital's, never edited or overwritten; a later update with different wording is added beside it with its source system and time; manual entry keeps what was typed or told as its source text. The procedure on a Booking is now just this text (no procedure master). The booking screens in both apps show it above the Contract and the RVG code, with who is invoiced and the pricing basis. A separate invoice description, starting as the chosen line's description else the Booking's description and editable without touching the received texts, is what the invoice prints (US-02.5.7, US-03.1.9, US-08.4.6, US-03.1.2, US-02.3.1, US-02.4.1). Open: which description the invoice prints for an RVG Contract (OQ-103), where each feed carries the text (OQ-13).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: One editable free-text Procedure.description (types.ts:825). IntegrationMessage keeps the raw message text (types.ts:1394) but the Booking does not; no history of wordings, no source system or time, no 'as given', no invoice description (invoice lines print the description).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Append-only source-text list on Procedure written by every intake path (manual create, integration, PDF ingest, matching screen), an editable invoiceDescription, and the stack on all booking screens, the review and the matching screen. Pairs with DM-13 (the chosen RVG sits under the text), DM-09 (line description) and DM-34.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Single description field confirmed; US-03.1.9 is status Open (2), still in scope.

dataModelDeltas.title: Who is billed: the Contract's holder or the payer named on the Booking, replacing the per-Procedure billable-party override and the billing routes
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Each Procedure's Contract decides who is billed: the holder's billable party record when the holder pays AA itself, otherwise the payer on the Booking. Every Booking names a payer (name and email) prefilled from the patient and editable by the office or the anaesthetist to a parent or guardian; the payer's email is required where the payer is billed; a patient under 18 as payer is a mild warning, not a block. A guardian is entered as the Booking's payer and kept for the life of the debt, not held as a master record. Billable parties are reference records (hospitals, surgeons, insurers and patients). One invoice per distinct billable party per Booking (FT-11.2, US-11.2.1 to US-11.2.4, US-04.2.1, US-08.2.1; OQ-67, OQ-54, OQ-78).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Per-Procedure: billablePartyId override pointing to a BillableParty master (a guardian record with relationship and contact; types.ts:195) created by createBillablePartyId (billablePartyActions.ts:21) with its own Xero contact (types.ts:1215). The default payer is the patient on the Billable Party route. The counterparty is a CounterpartyRef union of hospital, insurer, surgeon, organisation, patient and billableParty (types.ts:148) chosen by counterpartyForProcedure (invoiceBuild.ts:192). No Booking-level payer, no payer-email completion rule.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Booking gains payer fields (name, email), prefilled from the patient; counterparty resolution becomes holder-billable-party or Booking payer; the BillableParty master is repurposed as the reference table for hospitals, surgeons, insurers and patients, and the guardian master is replaced by the Booking payer; Xero contact keying stays on a hidden id (xeroHandoff.ts:79). 13 non-test files read billablePartyId. Needs DM-48 and DM-10; DM-28, DM-20 and DM-31 build on it.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: BillableParty is a guardian-style master and payer is per Procedure; no Booking-level payer anywhere in src (grep). Typo in draft function name left as authored in the delta file only; the prototype function is createBillableParty.

dataModelDeltas.title: Splitting a Procedure's fee between payers is a Booking action with typed $ or % shares, not a line-level funder override
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: On a Booking the user presses a button against a Procedure to split the invoiced fee between several billable parties; each share is a typed $ or %, and each party is invoiced its share on its own invoice. It is a user action, not a Contract or Procedure setting (the payment setting US-04.2.12 is Retired) and is separate from an additional invoice. The basis is our pick (OQ-68); whether % shares must total 100 is open (US-08.2.3, US-08.2.1, US-11.4.1; OQ-23).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: BillingLine.funderOverride (types.ts:908) with a conservation rule (once any line is overridden, line amounts must sum to the computed fee); office-only allocation through setBillingLineAllocation (billingLineActions.ts:138) and setProcedureFunderAllocation (:218). Grouping invoices by distinct counterparty per Booking is built (invoiceBuild.ts:264) and aligned.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Replace line-level overrides with a per-Procedure shares record (party, $ or %); the validator and allocation sheet adapt; invoice grouping is unchanged. Must move together with DM-46, which removes BillingLine, the carrier of the override today. Needs DM-11.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Both allocation functions confirmed in billingLineActions.ts.

dataModelDeltas.title: The Booking carries the insurer and the insurance approval number, recorded by the office; insurance guides the Contract but never decides who is billed
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Where a Booking is insured, the office records on it the insurer and the insurance approval number (the reference the insurer gives when it accepts the claim). A code such as SXAP from the rooms says the hospital is arranging the cover, not that it is approved. It is the office's job, not the anaesthetist's, who can complete the Booking without it; a Booking marked insured with no number sends the office to ring the rooms. A Booking that says an insurer will pay with no insurer Contract chosen is a warning at office review, not a block. No Insurer billing route remains. Open: whether the v6 design's insurer on the booking procedure is the same, and whether insurance narrows the Contract list (US-11.4.3, US-07.2.2, US-04.3.2; OQ-93).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: None. Procedure.insurerId (types.ts:838) is the payee of the Insurer billing route; accRelated (types.ts:855) is an informational flag.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Booking gains an insurer reference and an approval number (office edit, shown at review); insurerId stops being a route; the review warning rule lands with DM-31. Small, but the storage place (Booking or Procedure) waits on OQ-93.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: No approvalNumber or insurance reference field anywhere in src (grep).

dataModelDeltas.title: The NHI is mandatory with no blank: a Booking cannot be saved without one, and an incoming row without one waits at intake
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Every patient record has an NHI from creation, with no blank and no pending state; the NHI is the patient identifier throughout (an internal ID is only an implementation detail) and the dedupe key, one record per NHI. A Booking cannot be saved without an NHI. An incoming booking (feed or surgeon PDF) with none waits on the matching screen's unmatched queue, creating neither a Booking nor a patient, until the office adds the NHI; the office sees the waiting rows, marked urgent as the date nears. The earlier idea of a Booking proceeding with the NHI pending and authorising blocked is dropped. The anaesthetist sees the NHI; Bookings are searchable by NHI or name (US-11.1.1, US-11.1.4, US-11.1.5, US-02.1.4, US-03.1.5, US-03.1.7; OQ-49 answered 16 and 19 October).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Patient.nhi is optional (types.ts:173); upsertPatient creates a 'createdProvisional' record when no NHI is given and reuses by NHI when present (intake.ts:52); the UI prints 'NHI pending' (shared/format.ts:86). Dual-format validation (nhi.ts) and the hidden internal ID kept for Xero are fine. No waiting-row queue, no save guard, no search by NHI.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Patient.nhi becomes required; remove the provisional path and 'NHI pending' state (16 non-test files read the NHI); creation paths (manual, integration, PDF) refuse or park a row without one; the waiting rows live in DM-34's unmatched queue; search by NHI or name. Replaces the earlier problem-list-and-authorise-block design. The seed's patients need checking for blank NHIs.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: upsertPatient only validates an NHI when present (intake.ts:52 to :58); Patient.nhi optional at types.ts:173.

dataModelDeltas.title: A single Booking moves to a colleague by creating a List in the colleague's free Slot; whoever submits a List did its procedures
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An anaesthetist can move a single Booking as well as a whole List, only to a colleague who is free in that Slot (found by scrolling or type-to-filter). The move creates a List in the colleague's Slot holding the Booking; a Booking is never moved into another anaesthetist's existing List, and two Lists in a Slot are not supported (for now; OQ-85). A receiver on leave first sets their own Slot available, which is their acceptance. The mover may notify the admin pool or raise the update email, neither required; no not-preferred warning. The List's anaesthetist did every procedure on it: a Booking done by someone else moves to a List of theirs, even a one-Booking List, and its payable follows; a prepaid Booking's payable is the holding account, so nothing moves and nothing is recalculated (US-01.4.7, US-01.4.6, US-06.5.4, US-13.8.2; OQ-85, OQ-70).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: reassignBooking (lifecycle.ts:574) moves a Booking between Lists; an anaesthetist actor may only move between their own Lists (refused with 'notOwnList'), the office anywhere not AUTHORISED. The whole-List own move is built (listMoveActions.ts:208, :222, :240; Phase 32) but there is no single-Booking move, no creation of the receiver's List and no receiver-availability rule. Phase 32a is next.
dataModelDeltas.impact: An anaesthetist-actor single-Booking move that creates the receiver's List in a free Slot (the built Slot and List split makes this direct); the colleague finder (domain/listMoves.ts pushTargets :139) is reused for Bookings; an optional notice (DM-41). The earlier 'repoint the payable' step is gone: a payable follows the Booking by derivation and a prepaid one sits in the holding account (DM-21).
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: reassignBooking refuses cross-anaesthetist moves for an anaesthetist actor (lifecycle.ts:593); pushTargets exists at listMoves.ts:139.

dataModelDeltas.title: The shared notification pool gains an active or resolved state with who and when, and a second source: an anaesthetist's 'ask the office to check'
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: One pool for the whole admin team, separate from the to-do list, shown as a dashboard panel with active notices newest first and a count. A notice has two states only, active and resolved: any admin resolves it by ticking, which hides it for everyone (who and when are kept; a 'show resolved' filter brings it back), and it never expires; the same tick clears a to-do. There is no per-user read state. Sources: an anaesthetist moving a List (US-13.8.2) and, for now, an alert on a List or Booking with a note from an anaesthetist who is unsure about it ('ask the office to check', US-03.6.3, shown at office review in US-07.2.2); a single-Booking move may notify optionally (US-13.8.1, US-13.8.3, FT-13.8; OQ-79).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Built in Phase 32: Notification (types.ts:487), append-only, one kind 'listMoved', with 'no per-user, read or actioned state'; a Notifications screen and dashboard panel (store/notifications.ts, apps/admin/screens/NotificationsScreen.tsx). A notice cannot be resolved and nothing raises a check request.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Notification gains resolvedAtISO and resolvedBy (the append-only rule bends for the one tick), a 'show resolved' filter, a new kind carrying a note and a List or Booking link, an anaesthetist-app action, and review-queue visibility; the tick is shared with the warnings to-do (DM-31).
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: types.ts:480 to :500 and notifications.ts header confirm append-only, no resolved state.

dataModelDeltas.title: The anaesthetist profile holds bank account details (the rest of the master data is built)
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The anaesthetist profile holds contact details, registration number, HPI CPN where available, bank account details held in the system (not Xero only), and the dollar value per unit, which is the only billing setting; there is no GST period and no prepaid procedures. Surgeons' rooms (name, contact email and phone), the surgeon profile (room, registration number, HPI CPN), surgeon groups and a hospital contact email are master data (US-12.1.4, US-12.1.1, EP-12, US-13.6.1, US-13.6.2, US-13.4.1; OQ-14, OQ-52).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Built in Phase 17: surgeons' rooms, surgeon profile, surgeon groups and hospital contact email (types.ts:246, :260, :278, :286). Anaesthetist (types.ts:209) holds contact, unit value, HPI CPN, start date and active but no bank details, and still carries gstPeriod (see DM-29).
dataModelDeltas.impact: One field set on Anaesthetist plus an edit form in Master Data and seed values; used by the payables run's disbursement (DM-25; OQ-111). Low risk, can run any time. The earlier delta covered the whole profile; the rest is closed.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Anaesthetist interface (types.ts:209 to :232) has no bank fields.

dataModelDeltas.title: Hospital bookings land on a matching screen as import rows with an admin decision; unmatched rows and rows with no NHI wait in a queue
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The first release takes hospital bookings however each hospital provides them (St George's and Southern Cross are in scope, the particulars still to come; one theatre list a day for the next day) onto a review-and-merge screen. For each row the admin matches it to a List and Booking, creates a Booking on an existing List, creates a List in an anaesthetist's Slot, creates a Draft List, or rejects it; a later update to a matched Booking shows field differences for approval; each row shows its procedure text as received. Rows that cannot be matched, and rows with no NHI, stay in the unmatched queue until the office decides or adds the NHI; nothing is applied silently. The automatic schedule, pull on open, sync button and last-synced time were removed (US-02.1.5). Detecting removals from a re-sent List (US-02.2.3), surgeon PDF ingest (US-02.2.1) and automatic matching (US-14.6.2) are Future Work (US-02.1.1 to US-02.1.5, FT-02.1, FT-14.6; OQ-13, OQ-109).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Simulated HL7 and FHIR messages are applied straight to Bookings by processMessage (integrationActions.ts:328), with statuses, retry and dead-letter in an IntegrationMessage log (types.ts:1394); ingestPdfRow (:453) is a canned PDF. Integration writes are gated only by List state (editRefusal, lifecycle.ts:50). 'hospitalRow' is reserved as a Draft List origin (types.ts:567) but nothing emits it. No import row, no match decision, no difference view, no unmatched queue.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New ImportRow and MatchDecision entities and a queue screen; Booking writes from feeds move behind approval; the HL7 and FHIR message log is demoted (FT-14.1 and FT-14.2 are Future) or becomes the row source. The Slot, List and Draft List entities it creates into are built (Phases 28 and 31). Needs DM-51 and DM-30.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-02.2.1, US-02.2.3, US-14.6.2 are Future Work and are used only as boundaries; US-02.1.1 to 02.1.4 are in scope.

dataModelDeltas.title: Explicit-save change sets, an on-demand update email draft picked from the change history, and email templates
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An admin saves Booking edits explicitly (unsaved-changes warning); each save records the fields changed (before, after, who, when) in the append-only change history. A Booking's admin screen has an on-demand 'draft update email' button: the admin picks one or more changes and a mailto compose window opens prefilled with subject, boilerplate, the changes and the To address (hospital contact for a cover change, surgeon's room for a Booking change), about 2,000 characters, nothing sent or recorded. The office is offered the cover-change email from a List-move notice. Templates are user-configurable per kind of change (US-02.3.2, US-02.3.3, US-02.3.4, US-02.5.5; OQ-69, OQ-46, OQ-82; automatic sending is Future, US-02.3.5).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Append-only audit per mutation (AuditEntry types.ts:1095, mutate.ts), not grouped into save sets; edits apply immediately (editBooking, lifecycle.ts:416); no email draft and no templates. The contact emails it needs now exist (hospital and room, Phase 17).
dataModelDeltas.impact: A change-set grouping on audit entries (or a draft buffer), an email-draft launcher and a template master; the admin edit form becomes explicit-save. Launched from DM-41 notices. DM-32's addressing data is already built.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: No mailto or unsaved-changes handling anywhere in src (grep); US-02.3.5 Future is the boundary.

dataModelDeltas.title: Reference data: a master public-holiday calendar, a repeatable one-off data load and maintenance screens for the new masters
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Admins maintain all reference data in one place: hospitals with contact email, surgeons and surgeon groups, rooms, insurers, anaesthetists, Slot availability statuses, recurring bookings, the master public-holiday calendar and each hospital's own, RVG groups, modifiers, contract holders, and Contracts with their lines. It is loaded once by a developer-run data load (what is loaded, and from where, is not yet clear), repeatable so test systems can be wiped and reloaded, then edited by hand with every change recorded; clean cut, no migration. The Contract schedule upload is Future Work (US-04.2.13), its first-release need open (US-13.4.1, US-13.4.2, US-13.4.3, US-05.1.1; OQ-100).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: The Master Data screen has CRUD for hospitals, anaesthetists, surgeons and rooms, statuses, recurring bookings, holidays and Contracts (mastersActions.ts, surgeonActions.ts, slotStatusActions.ts, contractActions.ts). Holidays are per hospital only (types.ts:1000) with no master calendar; seed data are TypeScript fixtures; no data-load script.
dataModelDeltas.impact: CRUD for the new masters (RVG groups DM-13, holders DM-48, Contracts DM-07 and DM-09, modifiers DM-44), a master holiday calendar feeding each hospital's, and optionally a repeatable load script for seeds. Mostly follows the entity deltas.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: HospitalHoliday is per hospital only (types.ts:1000); US-13.4.1 lists the master calendar.

dataModelDeltas.title: Warning routine: the model and the dashboard to-do list are built; the remaining rules land as their source entities do
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: One routine checks Bookings and raises warnings, several per Booking, of a before- or after-procedure kind and mild or strong, which never block: unpaid prepayment, a billable patient with a balance, a child as payer, base units outside the RVG range, an insurer-will-pay Booking with no insurer Contract (office review). They show on the admin dashboard as a to-do list where an admin clears them, and as a warning triangle on the Booking in both apps, clearly visible when the anaesthetist opens it, with no confirm step on submit. Settings for thresholds and switching checks off are Future (FT-13.7, US-13.7.1 to US-13.7.3, US-07.2.2, US-11.3.2, US-11.2.4, US-03.3.1; US-13.7.4).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Built in Phases 15a and 15a2: Warning, WarningRule, WarningClearance and AppSettings (domain/warnings/types.ts), one registered rule 'prepaymentUnpaid' (WarningRuleId, types.ts:20), a stored office clearance outside the Booking, derived open warnings read by the admin dashboard to-do list (apps/admin/AdminApp.tsx:225) and a Booking flag in both apps.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Only the rules remain, each widening WarningRuleId as its source lands: child payer (DM-11), insurer-will-pay with no insurer Contract (DM-12), out-of-range units (DM-43), billable patient with a balance (DM-23). The dashboard tick also resolves notices (DM-41). A Contract changed by the anaesthetist is an audit and review flag (DM-10), not a warning.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: WarningRuleId is the single member 'prepaymentUnpaid' (domain/warnings/types.ts:20); admin dashboard reads warningSummaryByList.

dataModelDeltas.title: Prepayment: started by picking a prepaid Contract, amount is the line's price, invoice generated when an admin approves it, nothing calculated afterwards
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Picking a Contract flagged as prepaid starts the prepayment; it is always from a person paying for the patient, never an organisation (OQ-73), checked across the whole Booking and re-checked when Procedures, Contract or payer change (not on a move). The prepaid amount is the full price on that Contract's line, which always has one, shown to the anaesthetist; never a deposit, part or estimate. The invoice is generated when an admin approves it on the screen where outgoing invoices are approved (not at setup, not on receipt), then sent with a standard letter; its pair is a receivable from the payer on the Booking and a payable to the prepay holding account (DM-21); a later submit does not invoice it again. A prepaid Procedure keeps the price on its issued invoice if the Contract's price changes (OQ-104). After authorisation the prepaid amount is the price and BTM is reference only: no automatic invoice or credit, no threshold; extra work or a credit is raised by hand. Unpaid is a warning, never a gate (FT-06.2 to FT-06.4, US-06.2.1, US-06.2.2, US-06.3.1, US-06.3.2, US-06.3.5, US-06.3.6, US-06.4.1, US-08.2.2; OQ-76, OQ-92, OQ-96, OQ-97, OQ-116).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Prepayment is Procedure.patientPaymentCategory 'selfFundedPrepayment' plus prepaymentDetail full or split (types.ts:794, :804, :846, :848), derived on the Billable Party route (bookingRequiresPrepayment, selectors.ts:574). The office raises the pre-procedure invoice by hand (raisePreProcedureInvoice, prepaymentActions.ts:52); a split deposit is a flat agreed figure with the balance billed at the run and a visible netting line (invoiceBuild.ts:296 to :460); a full prepayment invoices an estimated fee computed by feeFor, not a Contract price. Status is derived (selectors.ts:639) and the unpaid warning is built (domain/warnings/rules/prepaymentUnpaid.ts), which is aligned.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Remove PrepaymentDetail, the split path and the payment category; the trigger and amount read from the prepaid Contract's line (needs the prepaid flag in DM-07, DM-09 and DM-11); Invoice gains a 'held for approval' state and a letter-template master; no balance invoice at the run. The visible deduction line stays for mixed Bookings pending OQ-116. The earlier per-anaesthetist prepaid setting (DM-19) is dropped. Before DM-21.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: raisePreProcedureInvoice is an immediate office action (no approval state); FT-06.1, US-06.1.1, US-06.1.2, US-12.1.3 Retired confirm DM-19's drop.

dataModelDeltas.title: Prepay holding account: the prepayment's payable is a ledger account, and a second pair pays the anaesthetist who did the List at authorisation
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A prepayment is not paid to the anaesthetist: the other side of its pair is a prepay holding account, which the ledger treats like an anaesthetist's account (its balance is all the deposits for procedures not yet done), within AA's trust accounting. Prepayment is two steps: the money is collected into the account, then when the office authorises the List a second pair moves it to whichever anaesthetist did the List, in place of another invoice to the patient. A cancelled Booking's prepayment is refunded in full from the account, recorded as a credit linked to the prepayment invoice that reverses its receivable and its payable to the account; a replacement Booking with another anaesthetist starts its own prepayment. A moved prepaid Booking changes nothing in the ledger (FT-06.4, FT-06.5, US-06.5.1 to US-06.5.4, US-09.1.3, US-08.3.1; OQ-70, OQ-80). Open: whether the cash refund is paid from the system or through Xero (OQ-115).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: No holding account (grep finds none). Soft cancel keeps the Booking and charges no fee (cancelBooking, lifecycle.ts:362) but refunds nothing. The prepayment's ACCPAY is to the anaesthetist and is released pro rata as money is received (payableRelease.ts:16; paymentActions.ts:69), so the anaesthetist can be paid before the procedure.
dataModelDeltas.impact: A ledger account entity (balance, entries) as the payee of the prepayment pair; the release rule holds the prepayment payable until authorisation and then creates the second pair to the List's anaesthetist (so a move needs no payee change); a refund credit (needs DM-24); draft Xero pairs to the holding account. Needs DM-20 and DM-22. Supersedes the earlier 'trust account' and 'repoint the payable' reading.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: No holding-account concept in src; payable released on receipt to the anaesthetist.

dataModelDeltas.title: Events on a Procedure (pre-op, post-op, billing event, additional invoice, credit, refund) replace the post-op addendum Booking and the other billing lines
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An event is anything recorded against a Procedure after it is set up: its own element attached to it, listed on the Procedure in both apps. Pre-op and post-op events carry their own date and time, record a time or a fixed fee, take no other modifiers, have an 'invoice' tick box and a 'same as the Procedure's billable party' tick. A billing event is a free-form charge with a text description, or a credit; the former other billing lines are merged into events, and a refund can also show as one. A billable event is its own line item on the Procedure's invoice if that is not yet approved, otherwise a separate invoice in the next run, through one standard review step; a Contract can replace a recorded time with a fixed fee. Covers pain management and ACC pre-op assessments (CS250, CS260, CS70 open) (FT-03.7, US-03.7.1 to US-03.7.3, US-08.6.1, US-05.5.2, FT-08.6; OQ-63, OQ-12).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: A post-op addendum is a new linked Booking (bookingType 'postOpAddendum', addendumOfBookingId; types.ts:760) running its own capture, submit, authorise and bill cycle (addPostOpAddendum, bookingActions.ts:199). Late fee lines are BillingLines added before invoicing (addBillingLine, billingLineActions.ts:46). No event record, invoice tick, billable-party tick or same-run versus next-run rule.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New Event entity (procedure, kind, date and time, time or fixed fee, invoiced flag, billable party or same-as, invoice link); replaces the addendum Booking (6 non-test files) and the post-invoice billing-line path; the billing run picks events up; one review step; both apps list them. After DM-10 and DM-08; DM-18 and DM-24 are event kinds. DM-46's removal of BillingLine waits on this.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: addPostOpAddendum at bookingActions.ts:199 and Booking.bookingType confirmed; OQ-63 answer confirms the event reading.

dataModelDeltas.title: Additional invoice: a free-form invoice recorded as an event, to any billable party, with its own ledger pair when raised after the original has gone
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An admin (any Procedure) or the anaesthetist (their own Procedure) presses a button against a Procedure to add a free-form invoice (per line description, quantity, amount; no Contract or unit rules) to any billable party. It is traceable both ways to the original Procedure and invoice, recorded as an event, goes through the standard review step, and, being raised after the original invoice has gone, has its own invoice number, ledger pair, Xero pair and anaesthetist payable (an event raised before approval is a line on that invoice instead). Uses: late post-op charges, extra work after prepaid or fixed-price work, splitting a combined Procedure (a credit note, then additional invoices that total the credited amount; a split before the List is authorised is a normal edit) (US-08.6.1, US-08.6.3, US-08.6.4, US-08.4.3, US-11.3.3; OQ-72, OQ-77).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Invoice.kind 'standard' | 'prePayment' (types.ts:1120) with a bookingId and no link to an original invoice or Procedure; priced lines only (InvoiceLine.procedureId optional, types.ts:1131). No free-form entry and no second-invoice lineage.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Invoice.kind widens (additional, credit note), with originalInvoiceId and procedureId; free-form line entry UI in both apps; the same pair creation and Xero handoff as any invoice; an event added before approval joins the invoice. Needs DM-17 and DM-22.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Invoice.kind is the two values confirmed at types.ts:1120.

dataModelDeltas.title: A wrong invoice is credited in full then rebilled; the payable is reversed by a negative invoice
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: An invoice is never edited, retracted or partly adjusted: it is credited in full (to any party, the original billable party included) and a new corrected invoice raised, each traceable to the original; the ledger payable and the Xero pair are reversed and re-created together. The reversal is a negative invoice to the anaesthetist, netted in their next payment run and shown on the remittance advice. A credit note is not a refund. The rebill may start from a draft copy of the original's lines. With no later payment to net against it is handled outside the system. Credit and new invoices are events on the Procedure (US-08.6.2, US-08.6.5, US-08.6.6, US-10.2.5, US-06.5.2; OQ-28, OQ-42, OQ-71, OQ-72, OQ-77).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Nothing: no credit note, no negative payable, no rebill; invoices are immutable once raised; BillingPipelineStatus runs pending, invoiced, handedOff, partPaid, paid, disbursed, failed, with no credited or reversed state (types.ts:1137 to :1145). invoiceBuild.ts:409 states a negative invoice is never raised.
dataModelDeltas.impact: CreditNote entity linked to its invoice, a negative payable record and Xero credit mirroring, a rebill-from-copy action, new BillingCase states. Needs DM-18 and DM-22; precedes DM-25's netting and DM-21's refund.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Draft said BillingCase moves only pending to disbursed or failed; the status set has seven values (invoiced, handedOff, partPaid, paid too) but no credited or reversed one. Substance upheld.

dataModelDeltas.title: The internal ledger holds both halves of each pair as its own records (including the holding-account payable), with the payable independent of Xero
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: For every invoice the engine creates a linked receivable from the billable party and a payable to the anaesthetist in its own ledger, the system of record, which Xero only mirrors as an ACCREC and a draft ACCPAY created together (a prepayment's payable is to the holding account instead). The ledger tracks money in and money out per patient and per anaesthetist and survives Xero contact archiving. Invoices are presented in the anaesthetist's name with AA as agent and a unique number; the payable carries the receivable's number with a '-P' suffix; each payable is a buyer-created tax invoice (new IRD name to confirm), one per procedure (FT-08.3, US-08.3.1 to US-08.3.4, US-08.4.3, US-08.4.5, US-09.1.1, US-09.1.4, US-10.1.2, EP-08; OQ-29, OQ-111).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: The ledger is the billing slice (Invoice, InvoiceLine, BillingCase with receivedAmount, authorisedAmount, disbursedAmount and Xero ids; types.ts:1112 to :1182), which the code calls a mirror and the apps read instead of Xero. The payable document and its amounts exist only as XeroAccPay in the Xero simulation (types.ts:1244), so the payable has no ledger record of its own. The '-P' number is stored (types.ts:1250); no buyer-created tax invoice wording.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Promote the Payable into the ledger (id, number, amount, authorised, disbursed, status, payee: anaesthetist or holding account) with Xero downstream; split BillingCase into receivable and payable sides; rewire payments, the payables run, selectors and the Xero view. Foundation for DM-21, DM-18, DM-24, DM-23, DM-25 and DM-29.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: XeroAccPay at types.ts:1244 with invoiceNumber at :1251; BillingCase carries amounts and Xero ids only.

dataModelDeltas.title: Derived ledger positions for the whole ledger, per anaesthetist and per patient; a flat outstanding list without ageing; patient balance alerts
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The Admin App shows the ledger's position at two scopes, the whole ledger (receivables outstanding, receipts held, payables due, amounts disbursed, any imbalance) and a single anaesthetist, and a patient's outstanding invoices across all anaesthetists, patient-centric even when a guardian pays (FT-13.2, US-13.2.1, US-13.2.2, US-08.3.5, US-11.3.1; the per-anaesthetist story US-13.2.3 is merged into US-13.2.1). The anaesthetist's outstanding list is flat, oldest first, with no ageing buckets or chips (US-12.2.1). Booking or matching a patient with a balance alerts staff: mild under the threshold (90 days from the invoice date, fixed until AA asks), strong above, mild for a credit balance, never a block; follow-up actions and invoice re-send are recorded (US-11.3.2, US-11.3.3; OQ-41, OQ-74, OQ-59).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: A per-anaesthetist outstanding list built per ACCPAY invoice with agingDays and a bucket (selectors.ts:874 to :952, AgingBuckets; used by apps/web/screens/AccountsScreen.tsx), which the catalogue now excludes. A boolean patientHasOutstandingPriorEpisode intake check (selectors.ts:552) shown as 'Prior balance' in the billing monitor; no threshold, mild or strong. No admin whole-ledger, per-anaesthetist or per-patient balance screen; no follow-up record.
dataModelDeltas.impact: New pure selectors over the ledger and three admin views; remove the ageing buckets from the web Accounts and dashboard screens; the threshold in appSettings; a FollowUpAction record. Needs DM-22 and DM-11; the alert rule lands in DM-31.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-12.2.1 confirms flat list, no ageing; selectors AccpayInvoiceRow carries agingDays and bucket.

dataModelDeltas.title: Weekly payment cycle with period approval of BCTIs and a remittance advice that nets negative invoices
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A payable is released when its receivable is paid, for exactly the amount received. Payments run on a weekly cycle named by ISO week: Friday the ledger is closed and snapshotted, Monday for the office to clear problems, Tuesday the schedule of released payables goes to the accountant, anomalies roll into the next cycle; a payment is shown against its week number. BCTIs for a period are approved for payment before the run (who approves is open). The anaesthetist's remittance advice shows invoices paid and negative invoices netted (US-10.2.1, US-10.2.5, US-10.2.6, US-10.2.7, FT-10.2; OQ-47). Whether the payment is made in Xero or from the new system is OQ-111.
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: runPayables (payablesActions.ts:147) pays every authorised-minus-disbursed amount at once under a payablesRunId (Disbursement, types.ts:1361). No cycle or week identity, no approval state, no held-out anomalies, no remittance advice, no netting.
dataModelDeltas.impact: PaymentRun entity (ISO week, status, held-out items), an approval state on payables, a remittance document, and netting of negative payables. Needs DM-24 and DM-22. Proposed in the catalogue, so keep it replaceable.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Disbursement at types.ts:1361 and runPayables confirmed; US-10.2.7 is status Proposed (still in scope).

dataModelDeltas.title: The GST report lists the payments AA passed to the anaesthetist in the month; the anaesthetist's GST period goes
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Each month each anaesthetist gets a list of the payments AA has passed to them in the month, with the GST component of each, for their GST return. It lists payments, not invoices sent, since an invoice may be paid in part; anything outstanding falls into a later month. It is something to download, email or print, so it suits the web app. There is no GST period on the profile (US-12.1.2 Retired: 'all they have is a unit rate'). All prices are held ex GST (US-12.2.2, EP-12, US-12.1.1, US-05.2.7; OQ-29).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: BillingReceipt carries a GST component of amounts received into AA (types.ts:1192; gstComponentOf, paymentActions.ts:34); the web Accounts screen's GST report reads those receipts. Anaesthetist.gstPeriod 'monthly' | 'biMonthly' | 'sixMonthly' (types.ts:215, :237) is held and edited (10 non-test files).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Re-base the report on payments made to the anaesthetist (the payable's paid side from DM-22) and group by calendar month; remove gstPeriod, its seed values and its editor. Follows DM-22.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: gstPeriod is read by 10 non-test files, not 11; substance upheld (US-12.1.2 Retired confirmed).

dataModelDeltas.title: Audit covers invoices, credit notes, master data and Contract changes but not disbursements, payments or receipts
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The audit trail shows who or what made each audited change: creates, updates, reassignments, authorisations, invoices, credit notes, master data changes, and Contract and time-entry changes. Disbursements, payments and receipts are not audited there, since they are recorded in Xero; how deep the audit goes is for the developers (US-13.5.2, FT-13.5).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: Every mutation is audited through mutate(), including simulated Xero payments and disbursements (paymentActions.ts 'xero.paymentReceived' at :186 and 'xero.accpayAuthorised' at :193; payablesActions.ts 'xero.disbursed' at :132).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Not a structural gap, kept as a small policy delta: the catalogue states an exclusion the prototype does not honour, but the prototype audits a superset and nothing is missing, so nothing has to change. A policy note: audit stays uniform in the demo, or payment and disbursement entries are filtered out of the audit viewer. Credit notes (DM-24) and Contract versions (DM-07) must be audited.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: Audit calls confirmed; reframed as a policy note rather than a model difference (a superset is not a missing structure). Candidate for the build plan to fold into DM-07 or DM-24 rather than a phase of its own.

dataModelDeltas.title: A SUBMITTED List stays editable by the anaesthetist until AUTHORISED, and a List leaves the anaesthetist's main view at AUTHORISED
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: Once a List is SUBMITTED the anaesthetist can still see it and change its Bookings until the office authorises it; changes are audited, the office sees them at review, the last change stands and neither side has authority over the other. Submitting only tells the office it has work to do and makes the List less prominent. The anaesthetist's main view shows upcoming work, earlier Lists not yet authorised and submitted ones not yet authorised; an authorised List leaves the main view (not at submit, not when billed, not on payment), its invoices show as outstanding balances, and it stays findable by search on patient name, NHI or date. AUTHORISED stays immutable (US-07.2.1, US-07.2.3, FT-07.2, US-07.4.1, US-07.4.2, US-03.1.6, US-03.1.7, US-07.3.2; OQ-31).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: editRefusal refuses an anaesthetist once a List is SUBMITTED ('Only the office can change it now'; lifecycle.ts:50 to :75, reassignBooking :574, the mobile submit flow). A List leaves the anaesthetist's forward views when the billing run stamps List.billedAtISO (types.ts:641; selectors.ts:390; apps/mobile/screens/ForwardListsScreen.tsx:76; apps/web/screens/DashboardScreen.tsx:88), not at AUTHORISED. The earlier pass counted both as aligned.
dataModelDeltas.impact: Relax the anaesthetist edit rule to ACTIVE and SUBMITTED (16 non-test files name 'SUBMITTED'), keep AUTHORISED locked, and make anaesthetist edits to a SUBMITTED List visible at review (audit already records them); switch the forward-view filter from billedAtISO to AUTHORISED and keep search for older work (catch-up Phase 38a). The billedAtISO stamp stays for the office monitor.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-07.2.1 and US-07.4.1 read directly; editRefusal lines 70 to 72 and selectors.ts:385 to :390 (comment says vanish at invoice generation) confirmed.

dataModelDeltas.title: An anaesthetist's unavailability is never a conflict: conflicts cover hospital closures only
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: A List conflicts only when its hospital is closed: a soft warning, never a block. An anaesthetist's unavailability, short-notice sickness included, is never a conflict flag: a List never stays with an anaesthetist who is unavailable, and they return it to the office or assign it to a colleague there and then, choosing what the vacated Slot becomes. A recurring booking landing on an unavailable Slot becomes a Draft List (US-01.5.2, US-01.5.4, US-01.5.5, US-01.4.3, US-01.3.2; OQ-81, OQ-84).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: ListConflict kind 'availability' | 'holiday' (types.ts:446); conflicts.ts derives an availability conflict for a List in a Slot with a closed status (expectedConflicts, conflicts.ts:114). The anaesthetist's own path is guarded (return or assign, built in Phase 32), but the office's sickness-record path keeps the List with the availability conflict as 'OQ-81 part 3, provisional' (availabilityActions.ts:190 applySessionWrites; store/demoSimulations.ts:49 simulateSickness; the Conflicts screen).
dataModelDeltas.impact: Remove the 'availability' conflict kind and its derivation; the office recording sickness must also force a return or assign (or send the List to the Draft Lists); the Conflicts screen and dashboard shrink to holiday closures; tests and the sickness demo trigger are rewritten. Independent of every other delta.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-01.5.2 and US-01.5.5 read directly; conflicts.ts:126 pushes an availability conflict and applySessionWrites comment confirms the office path keeps the List.

dataModelDeltas.title: Contract changes are staged, reviewed on a dashboard and submitted together as a new dated version
dataModelDeltas.catalogue_says: The office maintains one Contract at a time on a header and lines screen. Edits are not applied straight away but staged and shown on a review dashboard for that Contract; the office reviews them, sets the effective date and submits together, all or nothing, creating the new dated version and recording what changed. The dashboard shows header changes before and after, counts of lines added, altered, removed and unchanged, each altered line's changed values (highlighting any that become blank), errors that block submit (duplicate codes, a missing or past effective date, a second future-dated version) and warnings that do not (affected Bookings). A one-line fix follows the same path. Upload in the AA template (Alter or Replace) is Future Work (US-04.1.6, US-04.1.2, US-04.1.3, US-04.2.10, US-04.2.13; OQ-100 open for the first release).
dataModelDeltas.prototype_has: contractActions.ts edits a Contract and its price rows in place, immediately, with an audit entry (createContract :53, editContract :106, addContractPrice :200, editContractPrice :235). No staged change set, no diff, no effective-date step.
dataModelDeltas.impact: A staged ContractChange per Contract (header patch plus line adds, alters, removes) applied only on submit, a pure diff builder, and the review dashboard screen; submit creates the version through DM-07 and runs the relink and the affected-Booking list. After DM-07 and DM-09. The upload path stays out.
dataModelDeltas.verify_note: US-04.1.6 (status Proposed, not Future Work) in scope; US-04.2.13 upload is Future Work and excluded.

deltaSummary: Verified all 39 draft deltas against the catalogue and the code; none refuted or dropped, 4 corrected (DM-16, DM-24, DM-29, DM-45), 35 upheld, none added. Scope checked: every cited item is neither Retired (status 6) nor in the Future Work lane, except where a delta names it as a boundary (US-05.1.6, US-03.3.5/6/7, US-04.2.5, US-04.4.x, US-12.1.2 etc. Retired; US-02.2.1, US-02.2.3, US-04.2.13, US-14.6.2, US-13.7.4 Future Work). Corrections: DM-24 prototype_has misdescribed BillingCase (BillingPipelineStatus has seven statuses, pending to disbursed or failed, but no credited or reversed state; types.ts:1137); DM-45 reframed as a policy note, not a structural gap (kept, size S); DM-29 gstPeriod is read by 10 non-test files, not 11; DM-16 email stamp is billingRun.ts:411, not :399. Code re-checked and upheld: DM-55 (editRefusal refuses an anaesthetist on SUBMITTED, lifecycle.ts:70; forward views key on billedAtISO, selectors.ts:390), DM-56 (office sickness path keeps the availability conflict, availabilityActions.ts:190, conflicts.ts:126), DM-30 (upsertPatient tolerates a blank NHI, intake.ts:52), DM-41 (Notification append-only, no resolved state, types.ts:487), DM-32 (Anaesthetist has no bank fields, types.ts:209), DM-23 (agingDays and bucket in selectors.ts:874 to :952 while US-12.2.1 says flat, no ageing), DM-15 (splitBillingUnits fee.ts:107 gives time only to additional; no modifier split), DM-10/DM-13/DM-43/DM-46 validator lines :125, :130, :152, :222. No missed structural delta found after reading domain-model.md against types.ts: Slot, List, Draft List, recurring bookings, preferences and tiers, hospital and room contacts, AA fee invoice, ex-GST invoices and per-Booking failure all match. Domain-model-delta.md updated: a 'Verification pass' paragraph added before 'Suggested order' and the four corrections applied in place.
