reverseFindings.title: Attachments on Bookings and Lists are fully built
reverseFindings.explanation: US-03.1.3 retired 16 October (a real withdrawal, not a merge: Greg 'comfortable removing this feature', Ben does not want rooms' PDFs on a Booking). The anaesthetist can still attach a photo or file to any Booking and to a whole List on mobile and web; the office sees List attachments read-only; a theatre-list PDF is seeded on Souter's Tue 28 Jul List.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Code and US-03.1.3 notes confirmed; no other in-scope item supports attachments.

reverseFindings.title: GST period is a per-anaesthetist setting and a selector on the GST report
reverseFindings.explanation: US-12.1.2 retired 16 October (Greg: 'way too complicated... all they have is a unit rate'); the report is monthly. The prototype stores gstPeriod per anaesthetist, asks for it on add and edit, seeds Whitaker six-monthly, and the web report has a period switch defaulting to it.
reverseFindings.verify_note: gstPeriod in types, Add and Edit flows, AccountsScreen default confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: Rate x time billing line and the Method 3 'individual arrangement' Contract flag
reverseFindings.explanation: US-03.3.7 retired into US-03.3.6, itself retired into events (FT-03.7), and OQ-89 says a fixed-rate Contract prices the whole Procedure at BTM units x the Contract rate, so no billing line; the unit x rate line is removed. The prototype still offers hours x hourly rate gated by a Contract flag, with a seeded hourly Contract and seeded rate x time Bookings. Fixed ancillary lines can stay until events are built.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Flag, gate and sheet option confirmed in code; US-03.3.6 notes state the removal explicitly.

reverseFindings.title: Anaesthetist price adjustment: reason mandatory, offered on every Contract, no per-Contract flag
reverseFindings.explanation: US-03.5.3 retired into US-03.5.1, which now says no reason is needed (audit flag only) and that what the anaesthetist may change depends on a per-Contract flag (OQ-107). The prototype demands a reason from anaesthetist and office, offers adjustment on every Contract, and has no flag.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-03.5.1 acceptance criteria 'No reason' and 'Fixed price' confirmed against OverrideCard and validator.

reverseFindings.title: Prepayment is a per-Booking payment category with a split deposit or estimated full fee, netted automatically
reverseFindings.explanation: All retired. Live model: a Contract flagged prepaid triggers prepayment; the amount is always the fixed price on that Contract line, never an estimate, deposit or part; nothing is invoiced or credited automatically afterwards. The prototype keys prepayment on the billable-party route plus a Pre-payment payment category, then full or split; split is a flat deposit, full is a BTM-calculator estimate; the final invoice nets the deposit and invoices the balance; an overrun fails the Booking. The unpaid-prepayment warning (never a block) is correct.
reverseFindings.verify_note: bookingRequiresPrepayment keys on billableParty route and selfFundedPrepayment; validator demands full or split; FT-06.1 and US-06.2.5 notes confirm retirements.

reverseFindings.title: Protected default Type 1 Contract per hospital and direct-claim insurer, auto-created and used as fallback
reverseFindings.explanation: FT-04.4 and US-04.4.1 (retired) mandated a default Contract per hospital and insurer. US-04.3.3 replaces it: no hospital, insurer or procedure defaults and nothing derived from the List's location; the one default is No contract (RVG) billing the payer on the Booking. The prototype mints and protects a Type 1 default and falls expired or missing Contracts back to the holder's default, and resolves one from the List's hospital when nothing is stored.
reverseFindings.verify_note: defaultContractFor and resolveContractForProcedure read and confirmed; US-04.3.3 last paragraph is explicit.

reverseFindings.title: Second-procedure pricing keyed on the procedure ordinal
reverseFindings.explanation: Both retired 5 October by Donald: Contracts do not define second-procedure pricing; the RVG default applies (OQ-90 answered 19 October). The prototype lets an admin key a price row to an ordinal, prices an additional procedure from a fixed price only via an ordinal row, and seeds a $950 second-procedure price.
reverseFindings.verify_note: procedureOrdinal matching and the fee.ts ordinal exception confirmed; retirement notes confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: Additional procedures carry no modifier share; above-four modifier split missing
reverseFindings.explanation: US-05.3.3 retired into US-05.3.1, confirmed 19 October: base on the primary only, time on every Procedure from its own times, modifiers all on the primary while the Booking total is four or fewer, else divided equally with the remainder to the primary (7 over 3 = 3/2/2). The prototype gives additional procedures time units only (splitBillingUnits), locks B and M ('Not charged on an additional procedure') and has no split.
reverseFindings.verify_note: splitBillingUnits and UnitsCard captions confirmed; base lock is correct, the modifier lock and missing split are the drift.

reverseFindings.title: P1 'absorbed' by wrong codes and struck through instead of shown selected at 0 units
reverseFindings.explanation: US-05.2.3 was retired 2 October (a base code never absorbs a modifier) but US-05.1.4 and US-03.3.4 revive the idea differently: P1 is included in the six Neurosurgery codes (H7A to H9b) and the Spine codes S1 to S10, shown selected at 0 units so it cannot be added twice. The prototype marks seven demo codes as absorbing P1 (hip x3 and shoulder x2 are not in the RVG included-modifier CSV; only the two spine codes fit in concept), has no Neurosurgery codes, and renders an inert struck-through chip with a refusal caption instead of a selected 0-unit pill. Catalogue tension to flag: US-05.1.4 and Donald's 20 October decision say nothing is locked, but US-03.3.4's first paragraph still says it cannot be unselected.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Draft said 'refused silently' and 'locked, not removable'. Code shows a visible caption, and US-05.1.4 says not locked (20 Oct). Hip and shoulder codes absent from the RVG CSV confirmed; no H7A/H8a in rvgCodes.ts.

reverseFindings.title: Ranged base code is hard-bounded to the published range
reverseFindings.explanation: US-03.3.2 retired into US-03.3.1: the anaesthetist may enter any base units; out of range is accepted and raises an after-procedure warning for the office, never a block (OQ-32, OQ-56). The prototype offers only in-range choices and refuses completion outside the range.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Validator failure and RangeUnitsRow confirmed; US-03.3.1 acceptance criterion 'Out of range' confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: Engine re-resolves Contract and payer at billing time; nothing locked at AUTHORISED
reverseFindings.explanation: US-08.1.2 (retired into US-08.1.1): the engine does not resolve a route or payer; it reads the Contract locked to each Procedure, snapshotted at AUTHORISED (US-04.3.5). The prototype honours the stored Contract only while in effect, otherwise falls back to the holder default or resolves by route, derives the payer from route and holder, and snapshots nothing, so a later master edit or Resolve and retry changes what a re-run prices.
reverseFindings.verify_note: resolveContractForProcedure and counterpartyForProcedure read in full; no snapshot logic found in the store.

reverseFindings.title: Surgeon PDF upload and ingest shown unbadged as product
reverseFindings.explanation: US-02.2.1 is Future Work (swimlane; 2 October: not MVP); FT-02.2 ranks PDF ingest second to the hospital download. The Surgeon PDFs tab has no Future badge (the screen's own comment calls it proposed product UI) and offers facsimile review, NHI correction, per-row and Ingest all, an Ingest PDF row demo action, and Bookings seeded with source surgeonPdf. Data quality and Validators stay in scope.
reverseFindings.verify_note: TabButton for pdfs has no future prop; header comment confirms no badge.

reverseFindings.title: Automated modify, reschedule and cancel from hospital messages applied without review; day move applied as a move
prototype_evidence: aa-prototype/src/shared/demoTriggers/registry.ts:1017,1042 (fire and replay hospital message, badged future-scope)
reverseFindings.explanation: All Future Work lane. Canned S13 to S15 messages are applied by an integration actor with no admin review, including an S13 cross-List move, but US-02.5.2 (19 October) says a List never moves day: a Booking on another day is a cancellation plus a new Booking. US-02.5.4 (20 October) accepts inbound changes until AUTHORISED; the prototype refuses integration writes once SUBMITTED (editRefusal integrationImmutable). Concurrent edits (US-02.5.6) are not present. The demo actions and Messages tab are already badged Future, so the issue is the behaviour shown, not a missing badge.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Behavioural claims confirmed (US-02.5.2, US-02.5.4 text, lifecycle.ts:57-66). Added that the Fire and Replay demo actions are already badged future-scope.

reverseFindings.title: HL7 v2 to FHIR simulator, live drip and Scenario S1 built on them
reverseFindings.explanation: HL7 v2, FHIR R4 and near-real-time are Future; the in-scope release is the St George's and Southern Cross download into a manual matching screen. Phase 14 already badged the simulator, the Messages and Feed config tabs and the demo actions, and S1's text calls its beat a Future-scope illustration. Residual: the Integrations page intro says HL7 is 'translated to FHIR R4 and applied to the schedule', the simulator has a one-per-second live feed and raw PID segments, and S1 still opens the story with a pushed message creating a Booking. Rework S1 around sync into a matching screen (Phases 33, 34).
reverseFindings.verify_note: Draft claimed the Admin nav 'leads with' Integrations: false (eighth of ten, SideNav.tsx:45). Draft implied S1 unlabelled: its blurb says Future scope illustration. Size cut M to S.

reverseFindings.title: Reliability tooling: nav attention badge and patient names in the log are unbadged residue
prototype_evidence: aa-prototype/src/apps/admin/screens/IntegrationMonitorScreen.tsx:84-101,512-525 (attention banner, Reprocess, Patient column; Messages tab badged Future)
reverseFindings.explanation: FT-14.5 and US-14.5.1 are Future. The prototype retries three times on a timer, dead-letters, offers Reprocess and shows the patient's name on every log row, while US-14.5.1 wants a restricted working view. The Messages tab holding all of this is already badged Future with a Future-scope note; what stays unbadged is the amber attention badge on the side nav. Both fall away when Phase 34 demotes the tab.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Draft said shown as product with Hide from demo. Messages tab and FutureScopeNote already badge it; downgraded. Residual nav badge and Patient column noted.

reverseFindings.title: Further hospital feeds and automatic application with no matching step
reverseFindings.explanation: Extra feeds and automatic matching are Future; the first release keeps a manual matching review and a row with no NHI waits on the unmatched queue. The prototype has three feeds including Christchurch Public (not one of the two integrated hospitals) and creates the Booking straight onto the List with no review queue, last-synced display or unmatched queue. The in-scope matching screen does not exist (code is commented as interim until Phase 33), so the demo shows the Future end state.
reverseFindings.verify_note: No matching or unmatched-queue screen exists; US-02.1.5 text confirms nothing applies until an admin decides. Interim comment noted.

reverseFindings.title: Photo of the booking card still exists as a badged demo action
reverseFindings.explanation: Future Work. Phase 15b removed the chooser from Add a booking; photo capture is reachable only through the Future-scope demo action with simulated-capture badges. Low risk of misleading; keep the badge if shown.
reverseFindings.verify_note: AddBookingFlow comment and registry badge confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: Billing route plus Type 1/2/3 Contracts instead of one Contract per Procedure
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 08 route and governing-Contract rulings and the 7th review billing-route rulings. Catalogue: each Procedure selects exactly one Contract that sets price and who is invoiced; behaviour is set by flags not kinds; the anaesthetist can change the Contract until AUTHORISED; a Booking cannot complete without one. The prototype uses a per-Procedure route, Type 1/2/3 Contracts the office picks, a payment category driving funding, and completion that needs a route.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Route required at validator line 125; US-03.6.1 and US-03.3.1 confirm the Contract-based model.

reverseFindings.title: Anaesthetist edit rights end at SUBMITTED
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes binding convention 6 and the Phase 03/07 guards. Reversed 16 October (Donald: cut-off is Authorised): the anaesthetist can edit a submitted List until the office authorises it and the last edit stands. The prototype's editRefusal returns 'Only the office can change it now' on a SUBMITTED List, hides the controls, and the submit sheet says she cannot change the Bookings afterwards.
reverseFindings.verify_note: lifecycle.ts listSubmitted refusal and SubmitListSheet text read; US-07.2.1 acceptance criteria confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: A patient without an NHI is allowed (provisional record, 'NHI pending')
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the provisional-patient readings from Phases 03 and 10. The NHI is mandatory (Greg 19 October): a Booking cannot be saved without one, and an incoming row without one waits at intake and creates no patient record. The prototype treats the NHI as optional, creates provisional patients ('createdProvisional'), shows 'NHI pending' and seeds a no-NHI patient.
reverseFindings.verify_note: intake.ts provisional path and optional NHI in the form confirmed against US-11.1.4 acceptance criteria.

reverseFindings.title: Completion rules follow the RFP's route and times, not the Contract, and ask for no modifier explanation
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 04 completion-validation ruling. A Procedure completes when it has a Contract, its times only where the Contract prices from time, and an explanation for each modifier claimed; the RVG code is optional. The prototype requires a route, an RVG code or billing line, and start and handover whenever an RVG code is set (even on a fixed price), has no modifier explanation and no Contract check.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Validator lines 125-149 match the description; US-03.6.1 text confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: ASA class auto-seeds modifier units
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the 2026-07-22 ASA seeding values ruling and the design's ASA card. US-03.3.4 (20 October): only the age modifier and modifiers the base units include are pre-applied; nothing else is selected whatever the ASA grade; ASA is chosen like any other modifier with an explanation. The prototype adds the AS code to M from a dedicated ASA control. OQ-95 is still open, so label it a simplification.
reverseFindings.verify_note: fee.ts:79-84 seeds the AS code from asaClass; US-03.3.4 'Nothing else pre-filled' criterion confirmed. Lower confidence: OQ-95 open.

reverseFindings.title: Post-op addendum is a new linked Booking on today's free session
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 09 addendum reading. A pre-op or post-op event is an event on the original Procedure (own date and time, a time or fixed fee, no modifiers), billed through normal review; the original Booking stays immutable. The prototype creates a second linked Booking on a free session today that runs a full capture, submit and authorise cycle. A new Booking is still allowed for significant work (US-03.7.1 notes) but not as the standard path.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-03.7.1 text and notes read; addendum code path confirmed from the maps and registry.

reverseFindings.title: A prepaid invoice gets a full receivable and payable pair paying the anaesthetist; catalogue pays it into a holding account
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes Phase 09/10 decision D-pre-invoice-pair and the Phase 41 payee-repoint seam. 19 October (OQ-80): a prepayment goes to a prepay holding account, not the anaesthetist; the pair is created when an admin approves the prepayment invoice; a move changes nothing in the ledger; a second pair pays whoever did the List. The prototype has the office press 'Raise pre-procedure invoice' with no approval step and gives it an ordinary pair whose payable pays the anaesthetist. The settlement trigger is still to confirm.
reverseFindings.verify_note: handoffCasesForBooking comment cites D-pre-invoice-pair verbatim; OQ-80 answer confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: Unavailability including sickness still produces a conflict flag, and the office path keeps the List
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes Phase 30 (conflicts derived for an unavailable Slot, reassign from a closed session keeps its status) and Phase 31. Since 19 October an anaesthetist never keeps a List on a Slot marked unavailable, including short-notice sickness; transfer or return is forced when marked, and the conflict flag covers hospital closures only (US-01.5.2). The prototype still derives an availability conflict for a closed Slot, the Simulate sickness demo action marks the Slot unavailable while the List keeps its Bookings, and office assign accepts a closed session. US-01.6.3 is a tension the catalogue left open.
reverseFindings.verify_note: expectedConflicts raises for isClosed(slot.status); simulateSickness only calls setAvailability; US-01.5.2 text explicit.

reverseFindings.title: Provisional readings answered on 19 October are still built as provisional (vacated session, notices)
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 32 OQ-84 recommendation and notification-pool readings. OQ-84 answered: whoever moves a List is asked whether the vacated Slot becomes free or unavailable (only the 'open, still being confirmed' hint and comment are stale). OQ-79 answered 19 October: notices and to-dos are Active or Resolved, ticked off for the whole team, never expire, with an alert-the-office option on Lists and Bookings; the prototype keeps every notice with no resolve state (actionable false) and says what shows 'is still being confirmed'.
reverseFindings.verify_note: OQ-79 answer read in full; NotificationsScreen caption and NOTIFICATION_POOL_RULE confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: The office moves a single Booking to any List on any day (lower confidence)
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the 2026-07-22 third review #3. The explicit rule (US-01.4.7, OQ-85) is for the anaesthetist's own single-Booking move: only to a colleague free in that Slot, creating a List for it, never into an existing List, with type-ahead search. FT-01.4 and US-01.4.2 say the office also moves a Booking, through a finder of colleagues free in that Slot, so a same-Slot free-colleague target is the safest reading. The prototype office flow picks any target day and any existing List with an advisory pairing flag. Nothing in the catalogue forbids the office doing that, so treat it as an owner question, not a defect; the missing anaesthetist-side single-Booking move is a gap, not drift.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Draft overstated: the office half is not contradicted by any item. Size cut M to S, framed as owner question.

reverseFindings.title: Office edits to a Booking write through on every tap with no Save
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the 2026-07-23 Phase 04 'write-through per tap' ruling for the office only. US-02.3.2: an admin edit applies only on explicit Save, warns on leaving unsaved, and records changed fields for the update email; the anaesthetist keeps write-through. Admin Booking detail wraps the same shared body and has no Save, Discard or unsaved warning.
reverseFindings.verify_note: grep of AdminBookingDetail finds no Save, Discard or unsaved; US-02.3.2 acceptance criteria confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: Anaesthetist Booking shows no calculation, units or price (lower confidence, confirm with Donald)
prototype_evidence: aa-prototype/src/apps/web/screens/ListDetailView.tsx:77,182-183 (Units and Fee columns visible to the anaesthetist)
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the 2026-09-28 owner decision (no calculation, Off/Units/Fee control removed). US-03.1.2 has the anaesthetist see the Contract's pricing basis with the figure, and US-03.5.1 lets them change price, rate or discount where the Contract allows, which needs the price on screen. The demo is also inconsistent: the web List table shows units and fee while Booking detail hides them. The 28 September decision was Donald's own, so confirm before changing.
reverseFindings.verify_note: showBookingTotal gate and ListDetailView columns confirmed; PROGRESS.md 2026-09-28 entry read. Kept at lower confidence.

reverseFindings.title: Payer is a per-Procedure billable-party record tied to a 'Billable party' route
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the 2026-07-22 3rd and 7th review billable-party rulings. US-11.2.2: the payer is one per Booking, a name and email prefilled from the patient and editable by office or anaesthetist; every other arrangement is a Contract. The guardian-pays outcome is kept; the scope (Procedure vs Booking), fields and route coupling are not.
reverseFindings.verify_note: billablePartyId set only when route is billableParty; US-11.2.2 text confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: Funding split is an office-only per-line editor, not a Booking action with typed $ or %
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the 7th review A4/B4 ruling. US-08.2.3: a split is a user action on a Procedure's Contract line with each party's share typed as $ or %, each party gets its own invoice, no Contract or Procedure setting. The prototype editor is office-only, per billing line (funderOverride), amounts only, must sum to the fee. The two-funder outcome is kept.
reverseFindings.verify_note: funderOverride on BillingLine confirmed; US-08.2.3 acceptance criteria confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: Contracts edited in place, deletable, and the billing monitor un-end-dates one to retry
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes Phase 08 contract maintenance and the S4 billing-failure beat. US-04.2.10: each Contract is a series of dated versions; a change creates a new version from a chosen date never in the past; nothing is backdated or deleted; changes are staged and reviewed. The prototype edits dates and terms in place (editContract), lets the office delete an unreferenced Contract (deleteContract), clears an end date in Resolve and retry, and the S4 action ends a Contract in the past to force a failure.
reverseFindings.verify_note: editContract, deleteContract and the Resolve-and-retry effectiveToISO clear all read in code.

reverseFindings.title: GST report lists customer receipts, not the payments passed to the anaesthetist
reverseFindings.explanation: Supersedes the Phase 10 GST-activity reading. US-12.2.2 is a monthly list of payments AA has passed to the anaesthetist with the GST component of each (cash basis); a part-paid invoice falls into later months. The prototype lists receipts on the day the customer pays, before any payout, on mobile and web.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-12.2.2 text confirmed; prototype listing semantics from the maps and AccountsScreen.

reverseFindings.title: Dashboard Productivity and Leave panels
reverseFindings.explanation: US-12.2.3: the dashboard summarises calendar, financial position and locum availability. Productivity tiles have no backing; the Leave rows (Approved, Pending) imply an approval workflow while availability is something the anaesthetist sets herself. Both are seeded for one persona (Souter), not derived from Bookings or Slots.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Both panels and the hard-coded seed figures read in code.

reverseFindings.title: Receivables ageing buckets, age chips and an Overdue view
reverseFindings.explanation: OQ-59 answered: a flat list of unpaid payables, oldest first, no ageing buckets, no age chips, no Overdue view (Greg: 'We just want an age list'). The prototype has Current/31-60/61-90/90+ bars on the Dashboard, an Overdue tab with bucket columns and an amber age chip on every mobile Balances row.
reverseFindings.verify_note: US-12.2.1 and OQ-59 answer read; prototype references per the maps.

reverseFindings.title: 'Prior balance' tag has no threshold and sits on the billing monitor after authorisation
reverseFindings.explanation: US-11.3.2: the alert fires when a Booking is created or matched, for an invoice unpaid beyond a configurable 90-day threshold counted from the invoice date (mild or strong, yellow or red, never blocking; a credit is mild). The prototype tags any open prior episode with no threshold, only on the billing monitor and only after authorisation.
reverseFindings.verify_note: patientHasOutstandingPriorEpisode has no age test; US-11.3.2 criteria confirmed.

reverseFindings.title: Review flag 'ACC should not bill the patient directly'
reverseFindings.explanation: US-05.5.1: an ACC-funded Procedure is an ordinary Procedure priced by the contract holder's ACC Contract; ACC is invisible to the engine. The flag implies an ACC rule the engine lacks and derives from the billing route, so it falls away with the route model. The informational ACC chips on money lists are harmless.
reverseFindings.verify_note: reviewFlags.ts:75-88 read; flag keys on accRelated plus billableParty route.

reverseFindings.title: Modifier master is demo values and codes that differ from the transcribed RVG table
reverseFindings.explanation: The master should be the RVG modifier table plus AA's own list, values as the RVG prints. The prototype's 20 rows are labelled demo-plausible and disagree: AS3 is 3 (RVG 2), PA3/PA4 differ, PA5 is 1 (RVG 2 max), OB2 and OB4 bands shifted, AS2/PO1/PO2 do not exist in the RVG, VM1/TTE/PACU/EAA/POC missing. Age codes A1/A2 are ordinary removable chips rather than pre-applied from the date of birth. Pinned seed fees depend on AS3 = 3.
reverseFindings.verify_note: Compared modifierCodes.ts against NZSA RVG 2021 modifiers.md: AS3, PA3, PA4, PA5, OB bands, missing codes all confirmed.

Upheld unchanged: the other 32. Lower confidence remains on RV-22 (OQ-95 open) and RV-29 (Donald's own 28 Sept decision). Retired-item verdict table rows re-checked (US-04.2.9, US-04.2.7, US-05.2.4, US-04.4.2, US-09.1.2, US-01.3.4 are merges with no drift).
